attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'here in the ancient/ capital \t Mount Yoshino/ is so near that not/ a single day passes when/ the dazzling snow does not fall', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.139'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224428b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ならの京にまかれりける時に、やとれりける所にてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ならの京にまかれりける時に、やとれりける所にてよめる
attributes.field_text: みよしのの / 山の白雪 / つもるらし / 故郷さむく / なりまさるなり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / yama no shirayuki / tsumoru rashi / furusato samuku / narimasaru nari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / yama no shirayuki / tsumoru rashi / furusato samuku / narimasaru nari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the white snows must be/ piling thickly on lovely/ Yoshino Mountain/ for in the old capital/ a bitter cold penetrates', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.140'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224428c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: （寛平御時きさいの宮の歌合のうた）
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: （寛平御時きさいの宮の歌合のうた）
attributes.field_text: みよしのの / 山の白雪 / ふみ分て / いりにし人の / をとつれもせぬ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / yama no shirayuki / fumiwakete / irinishi hito no / otozure mo senu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / yama no shirayuki / fumiwakete / irinishi hito no / otozure mo senu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the one who trod this/ path through the untouched snows of/  fair Mount Yoshino/ sent not a word of greeting/ before leaving in silence', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.140'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224428d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 冬
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 冬
attributes.field_text: 白雪の / ふりしく時は / みよしのの / 山した風に / 花そちりける
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirayuki no / furishiku toki wa / Miyoshino no / yama shita kaze ni / hana zo chirikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirayuki no / furishiku toki wa / Miyoshino no / yama shita kaze ni / hana zo chirikeru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'when upon lovely/ Mount Yoshino \tthe heavy/  white snows swirl to earth/ the wind scatters the melting/ petals down to the foothills', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.151'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224428e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: やまとに侍りける人につかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: やまとに侍りける人につかはしける
attributes.field_text: こえぬまは / 芳野の山の / 桜花 / 人つてにのみ / 聞わたるかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: koenu ma wa / Yoshino no yama no / sakurabana / hitozute ni nomi / kikiwataru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: koenu ma wa / Yoshino no yama no / sakurabana / hitozute ni nomi / kikiwataru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'cherry blossoms of/  lovely Yoshino Mountain/ will be known to me/ only through the words of others  ̶   /until I too can go there', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.217-218'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224428f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: みよし野の / 山のあなたに / 宿もかな / 世のうき時の / かくれかにせん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / yama no anata ni / yado mo gana / yo no uki toki no / kakure ga ni sen
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / yama no anata ni / yado mo gana / yo no uki toki no / kakure ga ni sen
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'if only I had/ a home on the far side of/ fair Mount Yoshino/ I would make it my refuge/ In times of worldly sorrow', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.322'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244290
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 世にふれは / うさこそまされ / みよしのの / いはの陰道 / ふみならしてん
attributes.field_text_romaji: yo ni fureba / usa koso masare / Miyoshino no / iwa no kagemichi / fuminarashiten
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yo ni fureba / usa koso masare / Miyoshino no / iwa no kagemichi / fuminarashiten
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as I grow older/ afflictions alone increase  ̶ / I will walk onward/ treading the narrow pathways/ through the crags of Yoshino', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.322'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244291
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: もろこしの / よしのの山に / こもるとも / をくれんと思 / 我ならなくに
attributes.field_text_romaji: Morokoshi no / Yoshino no yama ni / komoru tomo / okuren to omou / ware naranaku ni
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Morokoshi no / Yoshino no yama ni / komoru tomo / okuren to omou / ware naranaku ni
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'although you retreat/ deep within the Yoshino/ Mountains \tdistant as/ far Cathay \tI am not one/ who will be left behind here', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.359'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244292
attributes.field_text: 春の朝、吉野山の桜は、人麿が心には、雲かとのみなむ覚えける
attributes.field_text_romaji: haru no ashita / Yoshino no yama no sakura wa / Hitomaro ga kokoro ni wa / kumo kato nomi nan oboekeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: haru no ashita / Yoshino no yama no sakura wa / Hitomaro ga kokoro ni wa / kumo kato nomi nan oboekeru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': '[…], and on a spring morning the cherry blossoms on Yoshino Mountain reminded Hitomaro of clouds.', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.42'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244294
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 花さかり / またも過ぬに / 吉野川 / かけにうつろふ / きしの山吹
attributes.field_text_romaji: hanazakari / matamo suginu ni / Yoshinogawa / kage ni utsurou / kishi no yamabuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hanazakari / matamo suginu ni / Yoshinogawa / kage ni utsurou / kishi no yamabuki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The flowers’ full bloom/ Is still not over, and yet,/ Yoshino river/ They fade in its reflection,/ Yamabuki on the banks.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244295
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 法師にならんの心ありける人、やまとにまかりてほと久しく侍てのち、あひしりて侍ける人のもとより、月ころはいかにそ、花はさきたりや、といひて侍けれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 法師にならんの心ありける人、やまとにまかりてほと久しく侍てのち、あひしりて侍ける人のもとより、月ころはいかにそ、花はさきたりや、といひて侍けれは
attributes.field_text: みよしのの / 吉野の山の / さくら花 / しら雲とのみ / みえまかひつつ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / Yoshino no yama no / sakurabana / shirakumo to nomi / mie magaitsutsu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / Yoshino no yama no / sakurabana / shirakumo to nomi / mie magaitsutsu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Yoshino Mountain/ On Yoshino Mountain/ The cherry blossoms/ As white clouds I confuse them/ Seeing them again and again.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244296
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 女につかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 女につかはしける
attributes.field_text: ひたすらに / いとひはてぬる / 物ならは / 吉野の山に / ゆくゑしられし
attributes.field_text_romaji: hitasura ni / itoi hatenuru / mono naraba / Yoshino no yama ni / yukue shirareshi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hitasura ni / itoi hatenuru / mono naraba / Yoshino no yama ni / yukue shirareshi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'So completely/ Am I to be despised- / If ’tis true, then/ On the mount of Yoshino/ I’ll find a place and tell no one!', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244297
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: かすならぬ / 身ををもににて / 吉野山 / 高きなけきを / 思ひこりぬる
attributes.field_text_romaji: kazu naranu / mi o omo ni nite / Yoshinoyama / takaki nageki o / omoikorinuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kazu naranu / mi o omo ni nite / Yoshinoyama / takaki nageki o / omoikorinuru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244298
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: 吉野山／こえん事こそ／かたからめ／こえむなけきの／数はしりなん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / koen koto koso / katakara me / koemu nageki no / kazu wa shiri nan
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / koen koto koso / katakara me / koemu nageki no / kazu wa shiri nan

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244299
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 法皇よしのの滝御らんしける御ともにて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 法皇よしのの滝御らんしける御ともにて
attributes.field_text: いつのまに / ふりつもるらん / 三吉野の / 山のかひより / くつれおつる雪
attributes.field_text_romaji: itsu no ma ni / furi tsumoruran / Miyoshino no / yama no kai yori / kuzureotsuru yuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: itsu no ma ni / furi tsumoruran / Miyoshino no / yama no kai yori / kuzureotsuru yuki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224429a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 右大将定国家の屏風に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 右大将定国家の屏風に
attributes.field_text: 白雪の / ふり敷ときは / 美よし野の / 山したかせに / 花そちりける
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirayuki no / furishiku toki wa / Miyoshino no / yama shitakaze ni / hana zo chirikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirayuki no / furishiku toki wa / Miyoshino no / yama shitakaze ni / hana zo chirikeru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224429b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: はらか
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: はらか
attributes.field_text: みよし野も / 若菜つむらん / まきもくの / ひはらかすみて / 日数へぬれは
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino mo / wakana tsumuran / makimoku no / hibara kasumite / hi kazoenureba
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino mo / wakana tsumuran / makimoku no / hibara kasumite / hi kazoenureba

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224429c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: たえてとしころになりにける女のもとにまかりて、雪のふり侍けれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: たえてとしころになりにける女のもとにまかりて、雪のふり侍けれは
attributes.field_text: みよし野の / 雪にこもれる / 山人も / ふるみちとめて / ねをやなくらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / yuki ni komoreru / yamabito mo / furu michi tomete / ne o ya nakuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / yuki ni komoreru / yamabito mo / furu michi tomete / ne o ya nakuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'In fair Yoshino/ Sealed in by snow,/ A mountain man:/ Searching out paths past,/ I wonder does he, too, weep aloud?', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224429d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 除目のころ、子日にあたりて侍けるに、按察更衣のつほねより、松をはしにてたへものをいたして侍りけるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 除目のころ、子日にあたりて侍けるに、按察更衣のつほねより、松をはしにてたへものをいたして侍りけるに
attributes.field_text: ひく人も / なくてやみぬる / みよし野の / 松はねのひを / よそにこそきけ
attributes.field_text_romaji: hiku hito mo / nakute yaminuru / Miyoshino no / matsubane no hi o / yoso ni koso kike
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hiku hito mo / nakute yaminuru / Miyoshino no / matsubane no hi o / yoso ni koso kike

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224429e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 冬さむみ / こほらぬ水は / なけれとも / よしのの滝は / ＊たゆる世もなし / ＊５たゆるまもなしイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: fuyu samumi / kōranu mizu wa / nakeredomo / Yoshino no taki wa / tayuru yo mo nashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: fuyu samumi / kōranu mizu wa / nakeredomo / Yoshino no taki wa / tayuru yo mo nashi

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224429f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 反歌
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 反歌
attributes.field_text: 見れとあかぬ / よしのゝ河の / なかれても / たゆる時なく / 行かへりみん
attributes.field_text_romaji: miredo akanu / Yoshino no kawa no / nagarete mo / tayuru toki naku / yuki kaerimin
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: miredo akanu / Yoshino no kawa no / nagarete mo / tayuru toki naku / yuki kaerimin

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b22442a0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 平さたふんか家歌合によみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 平さたふんか家歌合によみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 春たつと / いふはかりにや / みよし野の / 山もかすみて / 今朝はみゆらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: haru tatsu to / iu bakari ni ya / Miyoshino no / yama mo kasumite / kesa wa miyuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: haru tatsu to / iu bakari ni ya / Miyoshino no / yama mo kasumite / kesa wa miyuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Is it only because/ The calendar says spring has come?/ Even the mountains/  At Yoshino this morning/  Are faintly touched with haze.', 'source': 'Keene (1993): p.285'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 冷泉院東宮におはしましける時、歌たてまつれとおほせられけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 冷泉院東宮におはしましける時、歌たてまつれとおほせられけれは
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / みねのしら雪 / いつきえて / 今朝は霞の / たちかはるらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / mine no shirayuki / itsu kiete / kesa wa kasumi no / tachi kawaruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / mine no shirayuki / itsu kiete / kesa wa kasumi no / tachi kawaruran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: わか宿の / 梅にならひて / みよし野の / 山の雪をも / 花とこそみれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga yado no / ume ni naraite / Miyoshino no / yama no yuki o mo / hana to koso mire
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga yado no / ume ni naraite / Miyoshino no / yama no yuki o mo / hana to koso mire

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a3
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / たえすかすみの / たなひくは / 人にしられぬ / 花やさくらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / taezu kasumi no / tanabiku wa / hito ni shirarenu / hana ya sakuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / taezu kasumi no / tanabiku wa / hito ni shirarenu / hana ya sakuran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a4
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 芳野山 / きえせぬ雪と / 見えつるは / みねつつきさく / 桜なりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / kie senu yuki to / mietsuru wa / mine tsuzuki saku / sakura narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / kie senu yuki to / mietsuru wa / mine tsuzuki saku / sakura narikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: はつ雪をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: はつ雪をよめる
attributes.field_text: 都にて / めつらしと見る / はつ雪は / よしのの山に / ふりやしぬらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: miyako nite / mezurashi to miru / hatsuyuki wa / Yoshino no yama ni / furi ya shinuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: miyako nite / mezurashi to miru / hatsuyuki wa / Yoshino no yama ni / furi ya shinuran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: わかやとの / 雪につけてそ / ふるさとの / よしのの山は / 思ひやらるる
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga yado no / yuki ni tsukete zo / furusato no / Yoshino no yama wa / omoiyararuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga yado no / yuki ni tsukete zo / furusato no / Yoshino no yama wa / omoiyararuru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 入道摂政の家の屏風に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 入道摂政の家の屏風に
attributes.field_text: 見わたせは / 松の葉しろき / よしの山 / いく世つもれる / 雪にか有らん
attributes.field_text_romaji: miwataseba / matsu no ha shiroki / Yoshinoyama / ikuyo tsumoreru / yuki ni ka aruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: miwataseba / matsu no ha shiroki / Yoshinoyama / ikuyo tsumoreru / yuki ni ka aruran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: みたけに、としおいてまうて侍て
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: みたけに、としおいてまうて侍て
attributes.field_text: いにしへも / のほりやしけん / 吉野山 / やまよりたかき / よはひなる人
attributes.field_text_romaji: inishie mo / nobori ya shiken / Yoshinoyama / yama yori takaki / yowai naru hito
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: inishie mo / nobori ya shiken / Yoshinoyama / yama yori takaki / yowai naru hito

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442a9
attributes.field_text: しかはあれど、のち見むために、吉野川よしと言ひ流さむ人に、近江のいさら川いささかにこの集を撰べり。
attributes.field_text_romaji: shika wa aredo nochi mimu tame ni Yoshinogawa yoshi to iinagasamu hito ni Ōmi no Isaragawa isasaka ni kono shū o eraberi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shika wa aredo nochi mimu tame ni Yoshinogawa yoshi to iinagasamu hito ni Ōmi no Isaragawa isasaka ni kono shū o eraberi

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442aa
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 遠山桜といふこゝろをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 遠山桜といふこゝろをよめる
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / 八重たつ峰の / 白雲に / かさねてみゆる / 花さくらかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / yae tatsu mine no / shirakumo ni / kasanete miyuru / hana sakura kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / yae tatsu mine no / shirakumo ni / kasanete miyuru / hana sakura kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442ab
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 花薫風といふ心をよみ侍りける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 花薫風といふ心をよみ侍りける
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / みねの桜や / 咲ぬらむ / ふもとのさとに / 匂ふ春かせ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / mine no sakura ya / sakinuran / fumoto no sato ni / niou harukaze
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / mine no sakura ya / sakinuran / fumoto no sato ni / niou harukaze

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442ac
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 人人にさくらの歌十首よませ侍りけるによめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 人人にさくらの歌十首よませ侍りけるによめる
attributes.field_text: 桜花 / 咲ぬる時は / よし野山 / 立ものほらぬ / 峰のしら雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: sakurabana / sakinuru toki wa / Yoshinoyama / tachi mo noboranu / mine no shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: sakurabana / sakinuru toki wa / Yoshinoyama / tachi mo noboranu / mine no shirakumo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442ad
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 遥見山花といへる事をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 遥見山花といへる事をよめる
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / みねになみよる / 白雲と / 見ゆるは花の / 梢なりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / mine ni namiyoru / shirakumo to / miyuru wa hana no / kozue narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / mine ni namiyoru / shirakumo to / miyuru wa hana no / kozue narikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442ae
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 堀川院御とき、花のちりたるをかきあつめておほきなる物のふたに山のかたにつませ給て、中宮の御かたにたてまつらせ給へりけるを、宮御覧して、歌よめとおほせありけれはつかうまつれる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 堀川院御とき、花のちりたるをかきあつめておほきなる物のふたに山のかたにつませ給て、中宮の御かたにたてまつらせ給へりけるを、宮御覧して、歌よめとおほせありけれはつかうまつれる
attributes.field_text: さくら花 / 雲かかるまて / かきつめて / よしのの山と / けふは見る哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: sakurabana / kumo kakaru made / kakitsumete / Yoshino no yama to / kyō wa miru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: sakurabana / kumo kakaru made / kakitsumete / Yoshino no yama to / kyō wa miru kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442af
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 山さとに人人まかりて花の歌よみけるによめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 山さとに人人まかりて花の歌よみけるによめる
attributes.field_text: みな人は / 吉野の山の / 桜花 / おりしらぬ身や / 谷の埋木
attributes.field_text_romaji: mina hito wa / Yoshino no yama no / sakurabana / ori shiranu mi ya / tani no umoregi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: mina hito wa / Yoshino no yama no / sakurabana / ori shiranu mi ya / tani no umoregi

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 天徳四年内裏歌合によめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 天徳四年内裏歌合によめる
attributes.field_text: ふる里は / 春めきにけり / みよしのの / ＊みかきか原は / 霞こめたり / ＊４みかきか原をイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: furusato wa / harume kinikeri / Miyoshino no / Mikaki ga hara wa / kasumi kometari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: furusato wa / harume kinikeri / Miyoshino no / Mikaki ga hara wa / kasumi kometari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The old capital/  Is given over to spring;/ At fair Yoshino/ The meadows of Mikaki/ Are covered over with mist.', 'source': 'Keene (1993): p.316'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おなし歌合によめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おなし歌合によめる
attributes.field_text: 白雲と / みゆるにしるし / みよしのの / 吉野の山の / 花さかりかも
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirakumo to / miyuru ni shirushi / Miyoshino no / Yoshino no yama no / hanazakari kamo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirakumo to / miyuru ni shirushi / Miyoshino no / Yoshino no yama no / hanazakari kamo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: みよしのの／きさ山かけに／たてる松／いく秋風に／そなれきぬらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / Kisayama kage ni / tateru matsu / iku aki kaze ni / sonare kinuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / Kisayama kage ni / tateru matsu / iku aki kaze ni / sonare kinuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'At fair Yoshino/ In the shade of Kisa mou[n]tain/ Stands a pine:/ How many Autumn winds/ Have brought you to this pass, I wonder.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b3
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大和守にて侍けるとき、入道前太政大臣の許にて、初雪をみてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大和守にて侍けるとき、入道前太政大臣の許にて、初雪をみてよめる
attributes.field_text: としをへて / 吉野の山に / みなれたる / めにめつらしき / けさのしら雪
attributes.field_text_romaji: toshi o hete / Yoshino no yama ni / minaretaru / me ni mezurashiki / kesa no shirayuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: toshi o hete / Yoshino no yama ni / minaretaru / me ni mezurashiki / kesa no shirayuki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b4
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 堀河院御時、百首歌たてまつりけるによめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 堀河院御時、百首歌たてまつりけるによめる
attributes.field_text: わかこひは / 吉野の山の / おくなれや / おもひいれとも / あふ人もなし
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga koi wa / Yoshino no yama no / oku nare ya / omoiiredomo / au hito mo nashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga koi wa / Yoshino no yama no / oku nare ya / omoiiredomo / au hito mo nashi

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌たてまつりけるとき、初春の心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌たてまつりけるとき、初春の心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 雪ふかき / 岩のかけ道 / 跡たゆる / 吉野のさとも / 春はきにけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: yuki fukaki / iwa no kakemichi / ato tayuru / Yoshino no sato mo / haru wa kinikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yuki fukaki / iwa no kakemichi / ato tayuru / Yoshino no sato mo / haru wa kinikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 春日の社の歌合とて人人よみ侍けるとき、よめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 春日の社の歌合とて人人よみ侍けるとき、よめる
attributes.field_text: 吉野川 / みかさはさしも / まさらしを / 青根をこすや / 花の白浪
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa / Mikasa wa sashi mo / masaraji o / aone o kosu ya / hana no shiranami
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa / Mikasa wa sashi mo / masaraji o / aone o kosu ya / hana no shiranami

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 花の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 花の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / 花のさかりに / なりにけり / たゆる時なき / 峰の白雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / hana no sakari ni / narinikeri / tayuru toki naki / mine no shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / hana no sakari ni / narinikeri / tayuru toki naki / mine no shirakumo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 十首の歌人人によませさせ侍ける時、はなの歌とてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 十首の歌人人によませさせ侍ける時、はなの歌とてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 御吉野の / 花のさかりを / けふみれは / こしのしらねに / 春風そ吹
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / hana no sakari o / kyō mireba / Koshi no Shirane ni / harukaze zo fuku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / hana no sakari o / kyō mireba / Koshi no Shirane ni / harukaze zo fuku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'In fair Yoshino/ The blossoms’ bounty/ I see today, so/ In Koshi on Shirane peak/ The spring breezes will be blowing.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442b9
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首の歌奉りける、花の歌とて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首の歌奉りける、花の歌とて
attributes.field_text: 芳野山 / はなはなかはに / 散にけり / たえたえ残る / 峰のしら雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / hana wa nakaba ni / chirinikeri / taedae nokoru / mine no shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / hana wa nakaba ni / chirinikeri / taedae nokoru / mine no shirakumo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442ba
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 花の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 花の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_text: 御よしのの / 山下風や / 払らむ / 梢にかかる / 花のしら雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / yama shitakaze ya / harauran / kozue ni kakaru / hana no shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / yama shitakaze ya / harauran / kozue ni kakaru / hana no shirakumo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442bb
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 水辺款冬といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 水辺款冬といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 吉野川 / 岸のやまふき / 咲ぬれは / 底にそふかき / 色はみえける
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa / kishi no yamabuki / sakinureba / soko ni zo fukaki / iro wa miekeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa / kishi no yamabuki / sakinureba / soko ni zo fukaki / iro wa miekeru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442bc
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 吉野の滝をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 吉野の滝をよめる
attributes.field_text: 白雲に / まかひやせまし / 吉野山 / おちくる滝の / 音なかりせは
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirakumo ni / magai ya semashi / Yoshinoyama / ochikuru taki no / oto nakariseba
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirakumo ni / magai ya semashi / Yoshinoyama / ochikuru taki no / oto nakariseba

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442bd
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 円位法師かすすめ侍ける百首の歌の中に、花の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 円位法師かすすめ侍ける百首の歌の中に、花の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_text: いつくにて / 風をも世をも / 恨まし / 吉野の奥も / 花はちりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: izuku nite / kaze o mo yo o mo / urami mashi  / Yoshino no oku mo / hana wa chirikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: izuku nite / kaze o mo yo o mo / urami mashi  / Yoshino no oku mo / hana wa chirikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442be
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_text: 花そみる / 道の芝草 / ふみわけて / よしののみやの / 春の曙
attributes.field_text_romaji: hana zo miru / michi no shibakusa / fumiwakete / Yoshino no miya no / haru no akebono
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hana zo miru / michi no shibakusa / fumiwakete / Yoshino no miya no / haru no akebono
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I’ll see the blossoms/ parting grasses on ancient/ streets with each stride  ̶  / daybreak in springtime at/ palace ruins in Yoshino', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.45-46'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442bf
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 吉野なる / なつみの河の / かはよとに / 鴨そなくなる / 山陰にして
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshino naru / natsumi no kawa no / kawayodo ni / kamo zo naku naru / yamakage ni shite
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshino naru / natsumi no kawa no / kawayodo ni / kamo zo naku naru / yamakage ni shite
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'here in Yoshino/ on the Natsumi River/ floating in quiet/  eddies \ta duck is crying/ deep in the mountains’ shadow', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.270'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e6a7372ae5b22442c0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 世をいとふ / よし野のおくの / よふこ鳥 / ふかき心の / 程やしるらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: yo o itou / Yoshino no oku no / yobukodori / fukaki kokoro no / hodo ya shiruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yo o itou / Yoshino no oku no / yobukodori / fukaki kokoro no / hodo ya shiruran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'renouncing the world/ to dwell in Yoshino’s depths/ sweet-voiced song bird/ can it be you truly know/ my heart’s deepest recesses', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.606'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_text: みつのえの / 吉野の宮は / 神さひて / よはひたけたる / 浦の松かせ
attributes.field_text_romaji: mizu no e no / Yoshino no miya wa / kamisabite / yowai taketaru / ura no matsukaze
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: mizu no e no / Yoshino no miya wa / kamisabite / yowai taketaru / ura no matsukaze
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'at Mizunoe/ the palace of Yoshino/ is awe-inspiring/ ancient are the twisted pines/ howling in winds from the bay', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.656'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: いとひても / 猶いとはしき / 世なりけり / 吉野のおくの / 秋の夕暮
attributes.field_text_romaji: itoite mo / nao itowashiki / yo nari keri / Yoshino no oku no / aki no yūgure
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: itoite mo / nao itowashiki / yo nari keri / Yoshino no oku no / aki no yūgure
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'despising the world/ I came here \twhere I must hate/ it all the more \tdeep/ in the mountains of Yoshino/ autumn evening gathers', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.662'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c3
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: 吉野川 / 岸の山ふき / さきにけり / 嶺の桜は / 散はてぬらむ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa / kishi no yamabuki / sakinikeri / mine no sakura wa / chirihatenuramu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa / kishi no yamabuki / sakinikeri / mine no sakura wa / chirihatenuramu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Yoshino River/ on its banks yellow mountain/ roses have opened/ surely the cherry blossoms/ of the peaks have all fallen', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.70'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c4
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / 桜か枝に / 雪ちりて / 花をそけなる / 年にもあるかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / sakura ga eda ni / yuki chirite / hana osoge naru / toshi ni mo aru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / sakura ga eda ni / yuki chirite / hana osoge naru / toshi ni mo aru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Yoshino mountains/ snow flakes scattering on bare/ branches of cherry/ trees \tsurely this is a year/ when the blossoms will come late', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.37'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 花のうたとてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 花のうたとてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / こそのしほりの / 道かへて / また見ぬかたの / 花を尋ねん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / kozo no shiori no / michi kaete / mada minu kata no / hana o tazunen
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / kozo no shiori no / michi kaete / mada minu kata no / hana o tazunen
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The pathway I marked/ when last year I made my way/  into Yoshino  ̶  / I abandon now to visit/ blossoms I have not yet seen.', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.160'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 芳野山 / 花やさかりに / 匂ふらん / 故郷さらぬ / 嶺のしら雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / hana ya sakari ni / niouran / furusato saranu / mine no shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / hana ya sakari ni / niouran / furusato saranu / mine no shirakumo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'on Mount Yoshino/  the cherry blossoms must now/ be their most dazzling  ̶  / reluctant to leave their old/ home \twhite clouds cling to the peak', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.43'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 春日社歌合とて人人歌よみ侍けるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 春日社歌合とて人人歌よみ侍けるに
attributes.field_text: ちりまかふ / 花のよそめは / よし野山 / 嵐にさはく / みねの白雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: chirimagau / hana no yosome wa / Yoshinoyama / arashi ni sawagu / mine no shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: chirimagau / hana no yosome wa / Yoshinoyama / arashi ni sawagu / mine no shirakumo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'from so far away/ petals dancing as they fall  ̶  / splendors of Mount/  Yoshino \tare white clouds whirled in/ Tumult by the summit storms', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.60'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 残春の心を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 残春の心を
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / 花の故郷 / あとたえて / むなしき枝に / 春かせそふく
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / hana no furusato / ato taete / munashiki eda ni / harukaze zo fuku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / hana no furusato / ato taete / munashiki eda ni / harukaze zo fuku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'At the old capital/ in the hills of Yoshino/ the blossoms are gone;/ it is through empty branches/ that spring breezes are blowing.', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.172'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442c9
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 今夜たれ / すす吹風を / 身にしめて / 吉野のたけの / 月をみるらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: koyoi tare / suzufuku kaze o / mi ni shimete / Yoshino no take no / tsuki o miruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: koyoi tare / suzufuku kaze o / mi ni shimete / Yoshino no take no / tsuki o miruran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'who watches tonight/ as wind \tblowing through slender/ bamboo pierces his/ body \twho gazes upon/ the moon on Yoshino’s Peak', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.168'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442ca
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 世をのかれて後百首歌よみ侍けるに、花歌とて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 世をのかれて後百首歌よみ侍けるに、花歌とて
attributes.field_text: 今は我 / よし野の山の / 花をこそ / やとの物とも / 見るへかりけれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: ima wa waga / Yoshino no yama no / hana o koso / yado no mono tomo / mirubekarikere
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ima wa waga / Yoshino no yama no / hana o koso / yado no mono tomo / mirubekarikere
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'now at long last I/ can view the fairest blooms/ of the mountains of/ Yoshino as garden flowers/ at my own new residence', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.601-602'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442cb
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 吉野山 / やかて出しと / 思ふ身を / 花ちりなはと / 人やまつらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinoyama / yagate ideshi to / omou mi o / hana chirinaba to / hito ya matsuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinoyama / yagate ideshi to / omou mi o / hana chirinaba to / hito ya matsuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Here I am, thinking/ I may never again leave/ the Yoshino hills,/ while they think as they wait,/ “Surely once the blossoms fall…”', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.164'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442cc
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 最勝四天王院障子に、吉野山かきたる所
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 最勝四天王院障子に、吉野山かきたる所
attributes.field_text: みよし野の / たかねのさくら / 散にけり / 嵐もしろき / 春のあけほの
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / takane no sakura / chirinikeri / arashi mo shiroki / haru no akebono
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / takane no sakura / chirinikeri / arashi mo shiroki / haru no akebono
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Flowers must be falling/  on Yoshino’s peaks:/ this spring dawn’s/ gusting winds/ blossom in white.', 'source': 'Shirane (2007): p.616'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442cd
attributes.field_kotobagaki: なか月のつこもりの日、大井にてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: なか月のつこもりの日、大井にてよめる
attributes.field_text: 夕月夜 / をくらの山に / 鳴鹿の / 声のうちにや / 秋はくるらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: yūzuku yo / Ogura no yama ni / naku shika no / koe no uchi ni ya / aki wa kururan
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yūzuku yo / Ogura no yama ni / naku shika no / koe no uchi ni ya / aki wa kururan
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'is autumn leaving/  with the belling voices of/  the deer \tnow growing/ fainter on Mount Ogura/ as the twilight approaches', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.136'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442ce
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 朱雀院のをみなへしあはせの時に、をみなへしといふいつもしをくのかしらにをきてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 朱雀院のをみなへしあはせの時に、をみなへしといふいつもしをくのかしらにをきてよめる
attributes.field_text: をくら山 / みねたちならし / なく鹿の / へにけん秋を / しる人そなき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ogurayama / mine tachinarashi / naku shika no / heniken aki o / shiru hito zo naki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ogurayama / mine tachinarashi / naku shika no / heniken aki o / shiru hito zo naki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'wearing down the peak/ of Mount Ogura \tpacing/ loudly belling \t\tno/ one knows how many autumns/ this deer has cried for his love', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.174'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442cf
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 人のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 人のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: いかにせん / 小倉の山の / 時鳥 / おほつかなしと / 音をのみそなく
attributes.field_text_romaji: ika ni sen / Ogura no yama no / hototogisu / obotsukanashi to / oto o nomi zo naku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ika ni sen / Ogura no yama no / hototogisu / obotsukanashi to / oto o nomi zo naku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Oh what shall I do!/ On dark Ogura Mountain/ The summer cuckoo/ Is crying out and saying/ “I can’t see to find my way!”', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 春近く / ふる白雪は / 小倉山 / みねにそはなの / さかりなりける
attributes.field_text_romaji: haru chikaku / furu shirayuki wa / Ogura yama / mine ni zo hana no / sakari narikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: haru chikaku / furu shirayuki wa / Ogura yama / mine ni zo hana no / sakari narikeru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Spring is closing in/ And the falling white snow/ On Ogura Mountain/ On the peak there are flowers/  In the height of their bloom.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大井なる所にて人人さけたうへけるついてに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大井なる所にて人人さけたうへけるついてに
attributes.field_text: 大井川 / うかへる舟の / かかり火に / をくらの山も / なのみなりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ōigawa / ukaberu fune no / kagaribi ni / Ogura no yama mo / na nomi narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ōigawa / ukaberu fune no / kagaribi ni / Ogura no yama mo / na nomi narikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'On the Ōi River/ Float boats with/ Fishing fires and/ Gloomy Mount Ogura/ Is so in name alone.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 九条右大臣家の賀の屏風に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 九条右大臣家の賀の屏風に
attributes.field_text: あやしくも / 鹿のたちとの / 見えぬ哉 / をくらの山に / 我やきぬらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: ayashiku mo / shika no tachidono / mienu kana / Ogura no yama ni / ware ya kinuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ayashiku mo / shika no tachidono / mienu kana / Ogura no yama ni / ware ya kinuran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d3
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: もみちせは / あかくなりなん / をくら山 / 秋まつほとの / 名にこそ有けれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: momiji seba / akaku narinan / Ogurayama / aki matsu hodo no / na ni koso arikere
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: momiji seba / akaku narinan / Ogurayama / aki matsu hodo no / na ni koso arikere

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d4
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大井河に人人まかりてうたよみ侍けるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大井河に人人まかりてうたよみ侍けるに
attributes.field_text: 紅葉はを / けふは猶みむ / くれぬとも / をくらの山の / 名にはさはらし
attributes.field_text_romaji: momijiba o / kyō wa nao min / kurenu tomo / Ogura no yama no / na ni wa sawaraji
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: momijiba o / kyō wa nao min / kurenu tomo / Ogura no yama no / na ni wa sawaraji

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: をみなへしといふことを、くのかみにおきて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: をみなへしといふことを、くのかみにおきて
attributes.field_text: をくら山 / みねたちならし / なく鹿の / ＊へにける秋を / ＊しる人のなき / ＊４へにけむ秋をイ / ＊５しる人そなきイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ogurayama / mine tachinarashi / naku shika no / henikeru aki o / shiru hito no naki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ogurayama / mine tachinarashi / naku shika no / henikeru aki o / shiru hito no naki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 亭子院、大井河に御幸ありて、行幸もありぬへき所なりとおほせ給ふに、ことのよしそうせんと申て
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 亭子院、大井河に御幸ありて、行幸もありぬへき所なりとおほせ給ふに、ことのよしそうせんと申て
attributes.field_text: 小倉山 / みねの紅葉は / こころあらは / いま一たひの / みゆきまたなむ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ogurayama / mine no momiji wa / kokoro araba / ima hitotabi no / miyuki matanan
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ogurayama / mine no momiji wa / kokoro araba / ima hitotabi no / miyuki matanan
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'You autumn leaves/ on the slopes at Ogura  ̶  / if you have a heart,/ put off your falling this once:/ till the Emperor’s visit.', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.214'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 屏風絵に、夏のすゑにをくらの山のかたかきたるところをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 屏風絵に、夏のすゑにをくらの山のかたかきたるところをよめる
attributes.field_text: もみちせは / あかくなりなむ / 小倉山 / 秋まつほとの / なにこそありけれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: momiji seba / akaku narinan / Ogurayama / aki matsu hodo no / nani koso arikere
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: momiji seba / akaku narinan / Ogurayama / aki matsu hodo no / nani koso arikere

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 祐子内親王家歌合によみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 祐子内親王家歌合によみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 小倉山 / たちともみえぬ / 夕きりに / 妻まとはせる / しかそなくなる
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ogurayama / tachi tomo mienu / yūgiri ni / tsuma madowaseru / shika zo naku naru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ogurayama / tachi tomo mienu / yūgiri ni / tsuma madowaseru / shika zo naku naru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442d9
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 落葉埋橋といへる事をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 落葉埋橋といへる事をよめる
attributes.field_text: をくら山 / みねのあらしの / 吹からに / 谷のかけはし / もみちしにけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ogurayama / mine no arashi no / fuku kara ni / tani no kakehashi / momiji shinikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ogurayama / mine no arashi no / fuku kara ni / tani no kakehashi / momiji shinikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442da
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: おほろけの / 色とや人の / 思ふらむ / をくらの山を / 照すもみちは
attributes.field_text_romaji: oboroge no / iro to ya hito no / omouran / Ogura no yama o / terasu momijiba
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: oboroge no / iro to ya hito no / omouran / Ogura no yama o / terasu momijiba

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442db
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 小倉山 / 麓の野への / はな薄 / ほのかにみゆる / 秋のゆふぐれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ogurayama / fumoto no nobe no / hanasusuki / honokani miyuru / aki no yuūgure
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ogurayama / fumoto no nobe no / hanasusuki / honokani miyuru / aki no yuūgure
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Ogura Mountain/ at its foot flowering plume/ grass blankets the fields/  spearheads dimly visible/ this dusky autumn evening', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.152'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442dc
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: いつくにか / 今夜の月の / くもるへき / をくらの山も / 名をやかふ覧
attributes.field_text_romaji: izuku ni ka / koyoi no tsuki no / kumorubeki / Ogura no yama mo / na o ya kauran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: izuku ni ka / koyoi no tsuki no / kumorubeki / Ogura no yama mo / na o ya kauran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'could there be a place/ where tonight’s brilliant moon is/ hidden behind clouds  ̶  / even dusky Ogura/ Mountain must find a new name', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.175'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442dd
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: なく雁の / ねをのみそ聞 / 小倉山 / 霧立はるる / 時しなけれは
attributes.field_text_romaji: naku kari no /ne o nomi zo kiku / Ogurayama / kiri tachiharuru / toki shi nakereba
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: naku kari no /ne o nomi zo kiku / Ogurayama / kiri tachiharuru / toki shi nakereba
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the mournful cries of/ the wild geese are the only/  voices I hear on/ dark Ogura Mountain where/ the mists never lift or clear', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.209'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442de
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 小倉山 / ふもとの里に / 木のはちれは / 梢にはるる / 月を見るかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ogurayama / fumoto no sato ni / konoha chireba / kozue ni haruru / tsuki o miru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ogurayama / fumoto no sato ni / konoha chireba / kozue ni haruru / tsuki o miru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'in this village in dark foothills of Ogura Mountain \tthe trees have  lost their leaves \tin the tree tops I see the brightening moon', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.250'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e7a7372ae5b22442df
attributes.field_kotobagaki: みちのくにの白河関こえ侍けるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: みちのくにの白河関こえ侍けるに
attributes.field_text: たよりあらは / いかて都へ / つけやらむ / けふしら川の / 関はこえぬと
attributes.field_text_romaji: tayori araba / ikade miyako e / tsukeyaramu / kyō Shirakawa no / seki wa koenu to
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: tayori araba / ikade miyako e / tsukeyaramu / kyō Shirakawa no / seki wa koenu to

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 白河にて花のちりてなかれけるをよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 白河にて花のちりてなかれけるをよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 行末も / せきととめはや / 白川の / 水とともにそ / 春もゆきける
attributes.field_text_romaji: yukusue mo / seki todome baya / Shirakawa no / mizu to tomo ni zo / haru mo yukikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yukusue mo / seki todome baya / Shirakawa no / mizu to tomo ni zo / haru mo yukikeru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 白川院にて花をみてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 白川院にて花をみてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 東ちの / 人にとははや / 白川の / 関にもかくや / 花はにほふと
attributes.field_text_romaji: azumaji no / hito ni towabaya / Shirakawa no / seki ni mo kaku ya / hana wa niou to
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: azumaji no / hito ni towabaya / Shirakawa no / seki ni mo kaku ya / hana wa niou to

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 橘則光みちのくににくたり侍けるにいひつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 橘則光みちのくににくたり侍けるにいひつかはしける
attributes.field_text: かりそめの / 別とおもへと / しら川の / せきととめぬは / 涙なりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: karisome no / betsu to omoe do / Shirakawa no / seki todomenu wa / namida narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: karisome no / betsu to omoe do / Shirakawa no / seki todomenu wa / namida narikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e3
attributes.field_kotobagaki: みちのくににまかりくたりけるに、しら川の関にてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: みちのくににまかりくたりけるに、しら川の関にてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 宮こをは / 霞とともに / 立しかと / 秋風そふく / しら川の関
attributes.field_text_romaji: miyako oba / kasumi to tomo ni / tachishikado / akikaze zo fuku / Shirakawa no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: miyako oba / kasumi to tomo ni / tachishikado / akikaze zo fuku / Shirakawa no seki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I left the capital/ Together with the rising/ Mists of spring, but/ Autumn winds are blowing now/ At Shirakawa Barrier.', 'source': 'Keene (1993): p.302-303'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e4
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 二条関白、しら川へはな見になむといはせて侍けれはよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 二条関白、しら川へはな見になむといはせて侍けれはよめる
attributes.field_text: 春のこぬ / 所はなきを / 白川の / わたりにのみや / 花はさくらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: haru no konu / tokoro wa naki o / Shirakawa no / watari ni nomi ya / hana wa sakuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: haru no konu / tokoro wa naki o / Shirakawa no / watari ni nomi ya / hana wa sakuran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 白川院鳥羽殿におはしましける時、をのことも歌合し侍けるに、卯花をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 白川院鳥羽殿におはしましける時、をのことも歌合し侍けるに、卯花をよめる
attributes.field_text: 見て過る / 人しなけれは / 卯花の / さける垣ねや / 白川の関
attributes.field_text_romaji: mite suguru / hito shi nakereba / u no hana no / sakeru kakine ya / Shirakawa no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: mite suguru / hito shi nakereba / u no hana no / sakeru kakine ya / Shirakawa no seki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: （嘉応二年法住寺殿の殿上の歌合に、関路落葉といへる心をよみ侍ける）
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: （嘉応二年法住寺殿の殿上の歌合に、関路落葉といへる心をよみ侍ける）
attributes.field_text: もみちはの / 皆紅に / ちりしけは / 名のみなりけり / 白川の関
attributes.field_text_romaji: moimijiba no / mina kurenai ni / chirishikeba / na nomi narikeri / Shirakawa no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: moimijiba no / mina kurenai ni / chirishikeba / na nomi narikeri / Shirakawa no seki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: （嘉応二年法住寺殿の殿上の歌合に、関路落葉といへる心をよみ侍ける）
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: （嘉応二年法住寺殿の殿上の歌合に、関路落葉といへる心をよみ侍ける）
attributes.field_text: 都には / また青葉にて / 見しかとも / 紅葉ちりしく / 白川の関
attributes.field_text_romaji: miyako ni wa / mata aoba nite / mi shika domo / momiji chiri shiku / Shirakawa no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: miyako ni wa / mata aoba nite / mi shika domo / momiji chiri shiku / Shirakawa no seki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'In the capital,/ There still were leaves of green/ Upon which to turn my gaze, yet/ Scattered scarlet leaves cover/ The barrier at Shirakawa.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442e8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 羇中歳暮といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 羇中歳暮といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 東路も / 年も末にや / なりぬらむ / 雪ふりにける / 白川の関
attributes.field_text_romaji: azumaji mo / toshi mo sue ni ya / narinuran / yuki furinikeru / Shirakawa no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: azumaji mo / toshi mo sue ni ya / narinuran / yuki furinikeru / Shirakawa no seki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442ea
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: いくたひか / いく田のうらに / 立かへる / 浪に我身を / 打ぬらすらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: iku tabi ka  / Ikuta no ura ni  / tachikaeru / nami ni waga mi o / uchinurasuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: iku tabi ka  / Ikuta no ura ni  / tachikaeru / nami ni waga mi o / uchinurasuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Over and over/  To Ikuta Bay I have come/ And then gone back home/  The waves crashing over me/ Seem to have drenched thoroughly.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442eb
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: 立かへり / ぬれてはひぬる / しほなれは / いく田のうらの / さかとこそみれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: tachi kaeri / nurete wa hinuru / shio nareba / Ikuta no ura no / Saga to koso mire
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: tachi kaeri / nurete wa hinuru / shio nareba / Ikuta no ura no / Saga to koso mire
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Coming and going/ It is the tide where in time/ The dampness will dry/  That is simply natural/  When you visit Ikuta Bay.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442ec
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: つのくにの / いく田の池の / いくたひか / つらき心を / 吾そみすらむ
attributes.field_text_romaji: tsu no kuni no / Ikuta no ike no / iku tabi ka / tsuraki kokoro o / ware zo misuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: tsu no kuni no / Ikuta no ike no / iku tabi ka / tsuraki kokoro o / ware zo misuran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442ed
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 清家かちちのもとにあはの国にくたりて侍けるとき、かの国の女に物いひわたり侍けり、ちち津国になりうつりてまかりのほりけれは、女たよりにつけてつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 清家かちちのもとにあはの国にくたりて侍けるとき、かの国の女に物いひわたり侍けり、ちち津国になりうつりてまかりのほりけれは、女たよりにつけてつかはしける
attributes.field_text: 心をは / いくたのもりに / かくれとも / こひしきにこそ / しぬへかりけれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: kokoro o ba / Ikuta no mori ni / kakuredomo / koishiki ni koso / shinubekarikere
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kokoro o ba / Ikuta no mori ni / kakuredomo / koishiki ni koso / shinubekarikere

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442ee
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 摂津国にかよふ人の、今なんくたるといひて後にも又京にありけるをききて人にかはりてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 摂津国にかよふ人の、今なんくたるといひて後にも又京にありけるをききて人にかはりてよめる
attributes.field_text: ありてやは / をとせさるへき / 津の国の / 今そいく田の / 杜といひしは
attributes.field_text_romaji: arite yawa / oto sezarubeki / Tsu no kuni no / ima zo Ikuta no / mori to iishi wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: arite yawa / oto sezarubeki / Tsu no kuni no / ima zo Ikuta no / mori to iishi wa

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442ef
attributes.field_kotobagaki: つのくににすみ侍けるころ、大江ためもとか、任はててのほり侍けれは、いひつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: つのくににすみ侍けるころ、大江ためもとか、任はててのほり侍けれは、いひつかはしける
attributes.field_text: きみすまは / とはまし物を / つの国の / いく田の杜の / 秋のはつ風
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi sumaba / towamashi mono o / Tsu no kuni no / Ikuta no mori no / aki no hatsukaze
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi sumaba / towamashi mono o / Tsu no kuni no / Ikuta no mori no / aki no hatsukaze

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 夜泊廉と云心を読る
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 夜泊廉と云心を読る
attributes.field_text: みなと川 / うきねの床に / 聞ゆなり / いく田のおくの / さを鹿のこゑ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Minatogawa / ukine no toko ni / kikoyu nari / Ikuta no oku no / saoshika no koe
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Minatogawa / ukine no toko ni / kikoyu nari / Ikuta no oku no / saoshika no koe

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 恋侘ぬ / ちぬのますらお / ならなくに / 生田の川に / 身をやなけまし
attributes.field_text_romaji: koiwabinu / chinu no masurao / naranaku ni / Ikuta no kawa ni / mi o ya nagemashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: koiwabinu / chinu no masurao / naranaku ni / Ikuta no kawa ni / mi o ya nagemashi

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌よみ侍ける中に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌よみ侍ける中に
attributes.field_text: 昨日たに / とはむと思し / つのくにの / 生田の杜に / 秋はきにけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: kinō dani / towamu to omoishi / Tsu no kuni no / Ikuta no mori ni / aki wa kinikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kinō dani / towamu to omoishi / Tsu no kuni no / Ikuta no mori ni / aki wa kinikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'even yesterday/ I though [sic] that I would visit/ and now autumn has/ come to Ikuta grove in/ the fabled province of Tsu', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.127'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f3
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 伊勢の海に / 釣する蜑の / うけなれや / 心ひとつを / 定めかねつる
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ise no umi ni / tsuri suru ama no / ukenare ya / kokoro hitotsu o / sadame kanetsuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ise no umi ni / tsuri suru ama no / ukenare ya / kokoro hitotsu o / sadame kanetsuru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'restlessly drifts my/ heart \tas unsettled as the/ bobbing buoys of the/  fisherfolk who cast their nets/ into the sea at Ise', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.195'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f4
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: いせの海の / あまのつりなは / 打はへて / くるしとのみや / 思わたらむ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ise no umi no / ama no tsuri na ba / uchihae te / kurushi to nomi ya / omoi wataran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ise no umi no / ama no tsuri na ba / uchihae te / kurushi to nomi ya / omoi wataran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as never-ending/ as the relentless tasks of/ fisherfolk who cast/ their nets and reel them in on/ Ise Sea \tlove consumes me', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.195'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: いせのあまの / 朝な夕なに / かつくてふ / みるめに人を / あくよしもかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ise no ama no / asa na yū na ni / kazuku chō/ mirume ni hito o / aku yoshi mogana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ise no ama no / asa na yū na ni / kazuku chō/ mirume ni hito o / aku yoshi mogana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as fisherfolk of/ Ise dive for seaweed from/ morning until night  ̶   / oh that I might see you \ttill/ my longing could be sated', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.246'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: 朧けの / あまやはかつく / いせの海の / 浪たかき浦に / おふるみるめは
attributes.field_text_romaji: oboroge no / ama ya wa kazuku / Ise no umi no / nami takaki ura ni / ouru mirume wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: oboroge no / ama ya wa kazuku / Ise no umi no / nami takaki ura ni / ouru mirume wa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Could such a mediocre Fisherman harvest? I think not!/ The sea at Ise/ Sends waves high upon the shore/ Where the algae grows!', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 心にもあらてひさしくとはさりける人のもとにつかはしけ
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 心にもあらてひさしくとはさりける人のもとにつかはしけ
attributes.field_text: いせの海の / あまのまてかた / いとまなみ / なからへにける / 身をそ恨る
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ise no umi no / ama no made kata / itoma nami / nagaraenikeru / mi o zo uramuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ise no umi no / ama no made kata / itoma nami / nagaraenikeru / mi o zo uramuru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'By the sea at Ise/ A diver-girl does work/ Without surcease/ Endlessly/ I hate myself!', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 西四条の前斎宮、またみこにものし給ひし時、心さし有て思ふ事侍ける間に、斎宮にさたまり給ひにけれは、其あくるあしたにさか木の枝に付てさしおかせ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 西四条の前斎宮、またみこにものし給ひし時、心さし有て思ふ事侍ける間に、斎宮にさたまり給ひにけれは、其あくるあしたにさか木の枝に付てさしおかせ侍ける
attributes.field_text: いせの海の / 千尋のはまに / ひろふとも / 今は何てふ / かひかあるへき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ise no umi no / chihiro no hama ni / hirou tomo / ima wa nan chou / kai ga aru beki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ise no umi no / chihiro no hama ni / hirou tomo / ima wa nan chou / kai ga aru beki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442f9
attributes.field_kotobagaki: すかたあやしと人のわらひけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: すかたあやしと人のわらひけれは
attributes.field_text: いせの海の / つりのうけなる / さまなれと / ふかき心は / そこにしつめり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ise no umi no / tsuri no uke naru / sama naredo / fukaki kokoro wa / soko ni shizumeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ise no umi no / tsuri no uke naru / sama naredo / fukaki kokoro wa / soko ni shizumeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442fa
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 亭子院にさふらひけるに、御ときのおろしたまはせたりけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 亭子院にさふらひけるに、御ときのおろしたまはせたりけれは
attributes.field_text: いせのうみに / 年へてすみし / あまなれと / かかるみるめは / かつかさりしを
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ise no umi ni / toshi hete sumishi / ama naredo / kakaru mirume wa / kazukazarishi wo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ise no umi ni / toshi hete sumishi / ama naredo / kakaru mirume wa / kazukazarishi wo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442fb
attributes.field_kotobagaki: としよりかいせへまかることありてくたりけるとき、人人むまのはなむけし侍りける時よめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: としよりかいせへまかることありてくたりけるとき、人人むまのはなむけし侍りける時よめる
attributes.field_text: いせの海 / をののふるえに / くち果て / 都のかたへ / かへれとそ思
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ise no umi / ono no furue ni / kuchi hatete / miyako no katae / kaere to zo omou
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ise no umi / ono no furue ni / kuchi hatete / miyako no katae / kaere to zo omou

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442fc
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 恋の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 恋の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_text: 伊勢島や / いちしの浦の / あまたにも / かつかぬ袖は / ぬるる物かは
attributes.field_text_romaji: Iseshima ya / Ichiji no ura no / amata ni mo / kazukanu sode wa / nururu mono kawa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Iseshima ya / Ichiji no ura no / amata ni mo / kazukanu sode wa / nururu mono kawa

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442fd
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おなし御時うへのおのことも題をさくりて歌つかふまつりけるに釣舟をとりて読侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おなし御時うへのおのことも題をさくりて歌つかふまつりけるに釣舟をとりて読侍ける
attributes.field_text: いはおろす / かたこそなけれ / いせの海の / 塩瀬にかかる / あまの釣舟
attributes.field_text_romaji: iwa orosu / kata koso nakere / Ise no umi no / shiose ni kakaru / ama no tsuribune
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: iwa orosu / kata koso nakere / Ise no umi no / shiose ni kakaru / ama no tsuribune

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442fe
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 神風の / 伊勢のはま荻 / おりふせて / 旅ねやすらん / あらき浜へに
attributes.field_text_romaji: kamikaze no / Ise no hamaogi / orifusete / tabine ya suran / araki hamabe ni
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kamikaze no / Ise no hamaogi / orifusete / tabine ya suran / araki hamabe ni
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'spreading out the reeds/ growing along Ise shore/ where the divine winds/ blow \tdoes he break his journey/ there \tsleeping on the rough beach', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.375'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e8a7372ae5b22442ff
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 海浜重夜といへる事をよみ侍し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 海浜重夜といへる事をよみ侍し
attributes.field_text: いく夜かは / 月をあはれと / なかめきて / 浪におりしく / 伊勢の浜荻
attributes.field_text_romaji: ikuyo ka wa / tsuki o aware to / nagame kite / nami ni orishiku / Ise no hamaogi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ikuyo ka wa / tsuki o aware to / nagame kite / nami ni orishiku / Ise no hamaogi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'how many nights have/  I gazed in astonishment/ at the moon \there at/ Ise where waves break as I/ spread the reeds upon the shore', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.387'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244300
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: しらさりし / やそ瀬の浪を / 分過て / かたしく物は / いせの浜荻
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirazarishi / yasose no nami o / wakesugite katashiku mono wa / Ise no hamaogi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirazarishi / yasose no nami o / wakesugite katashiku mono wa / Ise no hamaogi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'forging through the waves/ of a myriad rapids/ unfamiliar to/ me \tI sleep alone \tspreading/  the reeds of the Ise shore', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.387'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244301
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 風さむみ / 伊勢の浜荻 / 分ゆけは / 衣かりかね / なみになくなり
attributes.field_text_romaji: kaze susami / Ise no hamaogi / wake yukeba / koromo karigane / nami ni naku nari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kaze susami / Ise no hamaogi / wake yukeba / koromo karigane / nami ni naku nari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'so cold \tthe wind \tas/ I make my way through the reeds/ on the Ise shore  ̶  / borrowing a robe \tcrying/ the geese fly above the waves', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.387-388'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244302
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 小莚に / 衣かたしき / 今宵もや / 我をまつらむ / うちのはしひめ
attributes.field_text_romaji: samushiro ni / koromo katashiki / koyoi mo ya / ware o matsuramu / Uji no hashihime
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: samushiro ni / koromo katashiki / koyoi mo ya / ware o matsuramu / Uji no hashihime
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'tonight once again/ does she spread but one side of/ her robe upon the/ mat \tbridge maiden of Uji/  do your arms still await me', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.247'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244303
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 忘らるる / 身をうちはしの / 中たえて / 人もかよはぬ / 年そへにける
attributes.field_text_romaji: wasuraruru / mi o Ujihashi no / naka taete / hito mo kayowanu / toshi zo henikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: wasuraruru / mi o Ujihashi no / naka taete / hito mo kayowanu / toshi zo henikeru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'forgotten \tforlorn/ am I \tfor our love crumbled/ like the Uji Bridge  ̶   / this whole year long \tthere has been/ no traffic across the gulf', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.285'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244304
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: ちはやふる / うちの橋もり / なれをしそ / あはれとは思 / 年のへぬれは
attributes.field_text_romaji: chihayaburu / Uji no hashimori / nare o shizo / aware to wa omou / toshi no henureba
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: chihayaburu / Uji no hashimori / nare o shizo / aware to wa omou / toshi no henureba
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'oh once vigorous/ guardian of Uji Bridge/ which I’ve so often/ crossed \thow pitiful to see/ you bent with the passing years', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.309'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244305
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: わか庵は / 都のたつみ / しかそすむ / よをうち山と / 人はいふなり
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga io wa / miyako no tatsumi / shika zo sumu / yo o Ujiyama to / hito wa iu nari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga io wa / miyako no tatsumi / shika zo sumu / yo o Ujiyama to / hito wa iu nari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'this is how I live/ in my retreat southeast of/ the capital \tthough/ men call Uji Mountain a/ reminder of worldly sorrow', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.332'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244306
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 宇治山の僧きせんはことはかすかにしてはしめをはりたしかならす （古注）
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 宇治山の僧きせんはことはかすかにしてはしめをはりたしかならす （古注）
attributes.field_text: わかいほは宮このたつみしかずすむ世をうち山と人はいふなり
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga io wa / miyako no tatsumi / shika zo sumu / yo o Ujiyama to / hito wa iu nari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga io wa / miyako no tatsumi / shika zo sumu / yo o Ujiyama to / hito wa iu nari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'This is how I live/ in my retreat southwest of/  the capital \tthough/ men call Uji Mountain a/  reminder of wordly [sic] sorrow', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.45'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244307
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おとこの、たたなりける時はつねにまうてきけるか、物いひてのちはかとよりわたれとまてこさりけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おとこの、たたなりける時はつねにまうてきけるか、物いひてのちはかとよりわたれとまてこさりけれは
attributes.field_text: たえたりし / 昔たにみし / うち橋を / いまはわたると / 音にのみきく
attributes.field_text_romaji: taetarishi / mukashi dani mishi / Ujihashi o / ima wa wataru to / oto ni nomi kiku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: taetarishi / mukashi dani mishi / Ujihashi o / ima wa wataru to / oto ni nomi kiku

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244308
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 宇治のあしろにしれる人の侍けれはまかりて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 宇治のあしろにしれる人の侍けれはまかりて
attributes.field_text: うち川の / 浪に見なれし / 君ませは / われも網代に / よりぬへき哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ujigawa no / nami ni minareshi / kimi maseba / ware mo ajiro ni / yorinubeki kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ujigawa no / nami ni minareshi / kimi maseba / ware mo ajiro ni / yorinubeki kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244309
attributes.field_kotobagaki: うちのとのといふ所を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: うちのとのといふ所を
attributes.field_text: みつもせに / うきぬる時は / しからみの / うちのとのとも / みえぬもみちは
attributes.field_text_romaji: mizu mo se ni / ukinuru toki wa / shigarami no / uchi no tono tomo (tonodomo) / mienu momijiba
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: mizu mo se ni / ukinuru toki wa / shigarami no / uchi no tono tomo (tonodomo) / mienu momijiba
attributes.field_volume: 巻第十九・離別　羈旅

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224430a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: なか月のつこもりの日、もみちにひをつけてをこせて侍けれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: なか月のつこもりの日、もみちにひをつけてをこせて侍けれは
attributes.field_text: 宇治山の / もみちをみすは / 長月の / 過行日をも / しらすそあらまし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Uji yama no / momiji o mizu wa / nagatsuki no / sugiyuku hi o mo / shirazu zo aramashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Uji yama no / momiji o mizu wa / nagatsuki no / sugiyuku hi o mo / shirazu zo aramashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'If I didn’t see/ Autumn leaves from Mount Uji/ I would not know that/ The days of the long month/ Had passed by like the hio.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224430b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 数ならぬ / 身をうち川の / あしろ木に / おほくの日をも / すくしつる哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: kazu naranu / mi o Uji gawa no / ajirogi ni / ōku no hi o mo / sugushitsuru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kazu naranu / mi o Uji gawa no / ajirogi ni / ōku no hi o mo / sugushitsuru kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224430c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 宇治にまかりて網代のこほたれたるをみてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 宇治にまかりて網代のこほたれたるをみてよめる
attributes.field_text: うち河の / はやくあしろは / なかりけり / なにによりてか / 日をはくらさん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ujigawa no / hayaku ajiro wa / nakarikeri / nani ni yorite ka / hi o ba kurasan
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ujigawa no / hayaku ajiro wa / nakarikeri / nani ni yorite ka / hi o ba kurasan

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224430d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 宇治平等院の主になりて宇治にすみつきて、ひえの山のかたをなかめやりてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 宇治平等院の主になりて宇治にすみつきて、ひえの山のかたをなかめやりてよめる
attributes.field_text: うち川の / そこのみくつと / なりなから / 猶雲かかる / 山そ恋しき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ujigawa no / soko no mikuzu to / nari nagara / nao kumo kakaru / yama zo koishiki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ujigawa no / soko no mikuzu to / nari nagara / nao kumo kakaru / yama zo koishiki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224430e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 河きりをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 河きりをよめる
attributes.field_text: うち川の / かはせも見えぬ / 夕きりに / まきのしま人 / 舟よはふなり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ujigawa no kawase mo mienu / yūgiri ni / maki no shimabito / fune yobau nari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ujigawa no kawase mo mienu / yūgiri ni / maki no shimabito / fune yobau nari

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224430f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 摂政左大臣家にてこひのこころをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 摂政左大臣家にてこひのこころをよめる
attributes.field_text: かすならぬ / 身をうち川の / はしはしと / いはれなからも / 恋わたる哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: kazu naranu / mi o Uji gawa no / hashibashi to / iwarenagara mo / koi wataru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kazu naranu / mi o Uji gawa no / hashibashi to / iwarenagara mo / koi wataru kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244310
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: あしろ木は / しつむみくつも / なかりけり / うちのわたりに / 我やすままし
attributes.field_text_romaji: ajirogi wa / shizumu mikuzu mo / nakarikeri / Uji no watari ni / ware ya sumamashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ajirogi wa / shizumu mikuzu mo / nakarikeri / Uji no watari ni / ware ya sumamashi

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244311
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 宇治にまかりて侍ける時、読る
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 宇治にまかりて侍ける時、読る
attributes.field_text: 朝ほらけ / 宇治の川霧 / たえたえに / 顕れ渡る / せせのあしろ木
attributes.field_text_romaji: asaborake / Uji  no kawagiri / taedae ni / araware wataru / seze no ajirogi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: asaborake / Uji  no kawagiri / taedae ni / araware wataru / seze no ajirogi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'In morning’s first light/ the mists on Uji River/ are all breaks and gaps  ̶   / and appearing everywhere,/ bamboo stakes of fishing weirs.', 'source': 'Carter, Steven (1991): p.225-227.'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244312
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 京極の前の太政おほいまうち君の高陽院の家の歌合に、祝の心を読侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 京極の前の太政おほいまうち君の高陽院の家の歌合に、祝の心を読侍ける
attributes.field_text: おちたきつ / やそ宇治川の / 早き瀬に / 岩こす浪は / 千世の数かも
attributes.field_text_romaji: ochitakitsu / yaso Ujigawa no / hayaki se ni / iwa kosu nami wa / chiyo no kazu kamo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ochitakitsu / yaso Ujigawa no / hayaki se ni / iwa kosu nami wa / chiyo no kazu kamo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244313
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 我恋は / 年ふるかひも / なかりけり / うらやましきは / 宇治のはし守
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga koi wa / toshi furu kai mo / nakarikeri / urayamashiki wa / Uji  no hashimori
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga koi wa / toshi furu kai mo / nakarikeri / urayamashiki wa / Uji  no hashimori

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244314
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 五十首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 五十首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: くれて行 / 春の湊は / しらねとも / 霞におつる / 宇治の柴舟
attributes.field_text_romaji: kurete yuku / haru no minato wa / shiranedomo / kasumi ni otsuru / Uji  no shibafune
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kurete yuku / haru no minato wa / shiranedomo / kasumi ni otsuru / Uji  no shibafune
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Toward what harbor/ spring goes when it fades away/ one cannot know  ̶  / a barge of firewood falling/ into River Uji’s haze.', 'source': 'Carter, Steven (1991): p.169'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244315
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 堀川院御時百首うた奉りけるに、霧をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 堀川院御時百首うた奉りけるに、霧をよめる
attributes.field_text: 麓をは / 宇治の川霧 / たちこめて / 雲ゐにみゆる / 朝日山かな
attributes.field_text_romaji: fumoto oba / Uji  no kawagiri / tachikomete / kumoi ni miyuru / Asahiyama kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: fumoto oba / Uji  no kawagiri / tachikomete / kumoi ni miyuru / Asahiyama kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'foothills enveloped/ by the mists rising above/ the Uji River/ while \tin the cloud-seat \tmorning/  sunlight strikes Mount Akashi', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.208'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244316
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 最勝四天王院の障子に、宇治川かきたる所
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 最勝四天王院の障子に、宇治川かきたる所
attributes.field_text: 橋姫の / かたしき衣 / さむしろに / 待夜むなしき / 宇治の曙
attributes.field_text_romaji: hashihime no / katashiki koromo / samushiro ni / matsu yo munashiki / Uji  no akebono
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hashihime no / katashiki koromo / samushiro ni / matsu yo munashiki / Uji  no akebono
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'on her thin straw mat/  robe half-spread to sleep alone/ maiden at the bridge/  awaiting the empty night/  in vain \tdaybreak at Uji', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.262'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244317
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 建久七年、入道前関白太政大臣、宇治にて人人に歌よませ侍けるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 建久七年、入道前関白太政大臣、宇治にて人人に歌よませ侍けるに
attributes.field_text: うれしさや / かたしく袖に / ＊つつむらん / けふ待えたる / 宇治の橋姫 / ＊３あまるらんイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: ureshisa ya / katashiku sode ni / tsutsumuran / kyō machietaru / Uji no hashihime
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ureshisa ya / katashiku sode ni / tsutsumuran / kyō machietaru / Uji no hashihime
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'was this happiness/ enfolded in her single/  sleeve \tspread as she slept  ̶  / the long-awaited day has come/ maiden of the Uji bridge', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.305'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244318
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 嘉応元年、入道前関白太政大臣宇治にて、河水ひさしくすむといふ事を人人よませ侍けるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 嘉応元年、入道前関白太政大臣宇治にて、河水ひさしくすむといふ事を人人よませ侍けるに
attributes.field_text: 年へたる / うちの橋守 / こととはむ / いく世に成ぬ / 水のみなかみ
attributes.field_text_romaji: toshi hetaru / Uji  no hashimori / koto towamu / ikuyo ni narinu / mizu no minakami
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: toshi hetaru / Uji  no hashimori / koto towamu / ikuyo ni narinu / mizu no minakami
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'oh \tguardian of/ the all-powerful Uji/ bridge I’ve so of the/  crossed \thow pitiful to see/ you bent with the passing years', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.306'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b2244319
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 摂政太政大臣家百首歌合に、鵜河をよみ侍りける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 摂政太政大臣家百首歌合に、鵜河をよみ侍りける
attributes.field_text: 鵜かひ舟 / あはれとそみる / もののふの / やそうち川の / 夕暗の空
attributes.field_text_romaji: ukaibune / aware to zo miru / mononofu no / yaso Ujigawa no / yūyami no sora
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ukaibune / aware to zo miru / mononofu no / yaso Ujigawa no / yūyami no sora
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'cormorant fishing/ boats \thow they tug at my heart/ myriad warriors/  of Uji River \tlights flicker/ under the evening sky', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.111'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224431a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 冬のころ大将はなれてなけくこと侍けるあくるとし、右大臣になりてそうし侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 冬のころ大将はなれてなけくこと侍けるあくるとし、右大臣になりてそうし侍ける
attributes.field_text: かかるせも / 有ける物を / 宇治川の / たえぬはかりも / なけきける哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: kakaru se mo / arikeru mono o / Ujigawa no / taenu bakari mo / nagekikeru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kakaru se mo / arikeru mono o / Ujigawa no / taenu bakari mo / nagekikeru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'although there have been/ times when my heart leapt like/ rapids on Uji/ River \tthere has also been/ heartache that our clan might end', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.673'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224431b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: もののふの / やそ宇治川の / 網代木に / いさよふ浪の / 行ゑしらすも
attributes.field_text_romaji: mononofu no / yaso Ujigawa no / ajirogi ni / izayou nami no / yukue shirazu mo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: mononofu no / yaso Ujigawa no / ajirogi ni / izayou nami no / yukue shirazu mo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'like waves wandering/ through the pilings of the weir/ in Uji \triver/ of the eighty warrior/ clans \tI know not where I go', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.674'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224431c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 家に月五十首歌よませ侍ける時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 家に月五十首歌よませ侍ける時
attributes.field_text: さむしろや / 待夜の秋の / 風ふけて / 月をかたしく / 宇治の橋姫
attributes.field_text_romaji: samushiro ya / matsu yo no aki no / kaze fukete / tsuki wo katashiku / Uji  no hashihime
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: samushiro ya / matsu yo no aki no / kaze fukete / tsuki wo katashiku / Uji  no hashihime
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'On a mat of rush/ as autumn winds deepen/ her night of waiting,/  the Maiden of Uji Bridge/ spreads a robe of moonlight.', 'source': 'Shirane, Haruo (2007): p.619'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224431d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大井なる所にて人人さけたうへけるついてに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大井なる所にて人人さけたうへけるついてに
attributes.field_text: 大井川  /  うかへる舟の  /  かかり火に  /  をくらの山も  /  なのみなりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ōigawa / ukabe ru fune no / kagaribi ni / Ogura no yama mo / na nomi nari keri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ōigawa / ukabe ru fune no / kagaribi ni / Ogura no yama mo / na nomi nari keri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'On the Ōi River/ Float boats with/ Fishing fires and/ Gloomy Mount Ogura/ Is so in name alone.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224431e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大井に紅葉のなかるるを見侍て
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大井に紅葉のなかるるを見侍て
attributes.field_text: 色色の  /  木の葉なかるる  /  おほゐ川  /  しもはかつらの  /  もみちとやみん
attributes.field_text_romaji: iroiro no / konoha nagaruru / Ōigawa / shimo ha katsura no / momiji to ya min
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: iroiro no / konoha nagaruru / Ōigawa / shimo ha katsura no / momiji to ya min

attributes.title: 5bfc17e9a7372ae5b224431f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おなし御時、大井に行幸ありて、人人に歌よませさせ給けるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おなし御時、大井に行幸ありて、人人に歌よませさせ給けるに
attributes.field_text: 大井川  /  かはへの松に  /  こととはん  /  かかるみゆきや  /  ＊ありしむかしを  /  ＊５ありしむかしもイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ōigawa / kawabe no matsu ni / koto towan / kakaru miyuki ya / arishi mukashi o
