attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: おもへとも / いはて忍ふの / すり衣 / 心の中に / みたれぬるかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: omoedomo / iwade Shinobu no / surigoromo / kokoro no uchi ni / midarenuru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: omoedomo / iwade Shinobu no / surigoromo / kokoro no uchi ni / midarenuru kana

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5709
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: みちのくの / 忍ふもちすり / 忍ひつつ / 色には出し / みたれもそする
attributes.field_text_romaji: Michinoku no / Shinobu mojizuri / shinobitsutsu / iro ni wa ideji / midare mo zo suru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Michinoku no / Shinobu mojizuri / shinobitsutsu / iro ni wa ideji / midare mo zo suru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a570a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 我床は / しのふの奥の / ますけ原 / 露かかるとも / しる人のなき
attributes.field_text_romaji: wa ga toko wa / Shinobu no oku no / masugehara / tsuyu kakaru tomo / shiru hito no naki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: wa ga toko wa / Shinobu no oku no / masugehara / tsuyu kakaru tomo / shiru hito no naki

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a570b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 君こふる / 涙時雨と / 降ぬれは / しのふの山も / 色付にけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi kouru / namida shigure to / furinureba / Shinobu no yama mo / irozukinikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi kouru / namida shigure to / furinureba / Shinobu no yama mo / irozukinikeri

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a570c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: いかにせむ / 忍ふの山の / 下紅葉 / 時雨るるままに / 色のまさるを
attributes.field_text_romaji: ikani semu / Shinobu no yama no / shitamomiji / shigururu mama ni / iro no masaru o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ikani semu / Shinobu no yama no / shitamomiji / shigururu mama ni / iro no masaru o

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a570d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 女に忍ひてかたらふこと侍けるを、きこゆることの侍けれはつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 女に忍ひてかたらふこと侍けるを、きこゆることの侍けれはつかはしける
attributes.field_text: いつくより / 吹くる風の / 散しけん / 誰もしのふの / 森のことのは
attributes.field_text_romaji: izuku yori / fukikuru kaze no / chirashiken / tare mo Shinobu no / mori no kotonoha
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: izuku yori / fukikuru kaze no / chirashiken / tare mo Shinobu no / mori no kotonoha

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a570e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 右大将兼長春日のまつりの上卿に立侍けるともに、藤原範綱か子清綱か六位に侍けるに、忍すりの狩衣をきせて侍けるを、おかしくみえけれは、又の日のりつなかもとにさしをかせ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 右大将兼長春日のまつりの上卿に立侍けるともに、藤原範綱か子清綱か六位に侍けるに、忍すりの狩衣をきせて侍けるを、おかしくみえけれは、又の日のりつなかもとにさしをかせ侍ける
attributes.field_text: きのふ見し / 忍ふもちすり / 誰ならむ / 心のほとそ / かきりしられぬ
attributes.field_text_romaji: kinō mishi / Shinobu mojizuri / tare naramu / kokoro no hodo zo / kagiri shirarenu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kinō mishi / Shinobu mojizuri / tare naramu / kokoro no hodo zo / kagiri shirarenu

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a570f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: うたあはせし侍ける時、旅のこころをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: うたあはせし侍ける時、旅のこころをよめる
attributes.field_text: 日を経つつ / 都忍ふの / 浦さひて / 浪よりほかの / 音つれもなし
attributes.field_text_romaji: hi o hetsutsu / miyako Shinobu no / ura sabite / nami yori hoka no / otozure mo nashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hi o hetsutsu / miyako Shinobu no / ura sabite / nami yori hoka no / otozure mo nashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'days pass in longing/  for the capital \tstorms rage/ over the waters/  of lonely Shinobu Bay/ no tiding but those of waves', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.399'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5710
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_text: うちはへて / くるしき物は / 人めのみ / しのふの浦の / 蜑のたくなは
attributes.field_text_romaji: uchihaete / kurushiki mono wa / hitome nomi / Shinobu no ura no / ama no takunawa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: uchihaete / kurushiki mono wa / hitome nomi / Shinobu no ura no / ama no takunawa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'endlessly reeling  ̶  / painful the gaze of strangers/ that I must endure  ̶  / fishermen of Shinobu Bay/ haul on mulberry ropes', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.450'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5711
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: あやなくも / 曇らぬよひを / いとふ哉 / しのふの里の / 秋の夜の月
attributes.field_text_romaji: ayanaku mo / kumoranu yoi o / itou kana / Shinobu no sato no / aki no yo no tsuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ayanaku mo / kumoranu yoi o / itou kana / Shinobu no sato no / aki no yo no tsuki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I cannot help but/ feel hatred for the cloudless/ night \tthe brilliant moon/ of autumn illuminates my/ retreat \tShinobu Village', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.167'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5712
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 前大僧正慈円、ふみにてはおもふほとのことも申つくしかたきよし、申つかはしてはへりける返事に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 前大僧正慈円、ふみにてはおもふほとのことも申つくしかたきよし、申つかはしてはへりける返事に
attributes.field_text: みちのくの / いはて忍ふは / えそしらぬ / 書つくしてよ / つほのいしふみ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Michinoku no / iwade shinobu wa / e zo shiranu / kakitsukushite yo / Tsubo no ishibumi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Michinoku no / iwade shinobu wa / e zo shiranu / kakitsukushite yo / Tsubo no ishibumi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'in Michinoku’s/ Iwade \tShinobu \tif/  you yearn in silence/ none can know \tsend a letter/ Tsubonoishibumi', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.725-726'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5713
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 春日社歌合に、落葉といふことをよみてたてまつりし
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 春日社歌合に、落葉といふことをよみてたてまつりし
attributes.field_text: 初時雨 / 忍の山の / もみちはを / あらしふけとは / 染すやあるらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: hatsushigure / Shinobu no yama no / momijiba o / arashi fuke to wa / somezu ya aruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hatsushigure / Shinobu no yama no / momijiba o / arashi fuke to wa / somezu ya aruran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'surely the first cold/ rains of winter have not left/ these autumn leaves on/ Mt. Shinobu undyed just/ to urge the storms to rage on', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.236'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5714
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 忍恋の心を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 忍恋の心を
attributes.field_text: 人しれす / くるしきものは / しのふ山 / 下はふ葛の / うらみなりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: hito shirezu / kurushiki mono wa / Shinobuyama / shita hau kuzu no / urami narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hito shirezu / kurushiki mono wa / Shinobuyama / shita hau kuzu no / urami narikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'unbeknownst to her/ such misery I endure/ hidden like the backs/ of creeping arrowroot leaves/ beneath Shinobu Mountain', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.449'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5715
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 和歌所歌合に、忍ふこひの心を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 和歌所歌合に、忍ふこひの心を
attributes.field_text: きえねたた / しのふの山の / 嶺の雲 / かかるこころの / 跡もなきまて
attributes.field_text_romaji: kiene tada / Shinobu no yama no / mine no kumo / kakaru kokoro no / ato mo naki made
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kiene tada / Shinobu no yama no / mine no kumo / kakaru kokoro no / ato mo naki made
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'let them disappear/ those clouds that are concealing/ Mount Shinobu’s peak/ until this yearning heart too is/ gone without a single trace', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.499-450'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5716
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_text: 限あれは / 忍ふの山の / 麓にも / おちはかうへの / つゆそ色つく
attributes.field_text_romaji: kagiri areba / Shinobu no yama no / fumoto ni mo / ochiba ga ue no / tsuyu zo irozuku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kagiri areba / Shinobu no yama no / fumoto ni mo / ochiba ga ue no / tsuyu zo irozuku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'there is a limit to/ endurance \tin the foothills/ of Mount Shinobu/ even dew drops covering/ the fallen leaves change color', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.450'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5717
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 竜田川 / 紅葉みたれて / なかるめり / わたらは錦 / 中やたえなん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / momiji midarete / nagarumeri / wataraba nishiki / naka ya taenan
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / momiji midarete / nagarumeri / wataraba nishiki / naka ya taenan
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'a covering of/ bright scattered leaves floats on the/ Tatsuta River  ̶  / were I to ford the waters/ the brocade would tear in half', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.128'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5718
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 竜田川 / 紅葉はなかる / 神なひの / みむろの山に / 時雨ふるらし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / momijiba nagaru / kamunabi no / mimuro no yama ni / shigure fururashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / momijiba nagaru / kamunabi no / mimuro no yama ni / shigure fururashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the brilliant autumn/ leaves float by on Tatsuta/ River \tfreezing rains/ must already be falling/ on holy Mount Mimuro', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.129'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5719
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 二条の后の、春宮のみやす所と申ける時に、御屏風に竜田川に紅葉なかれたるかたをかけりけるを題にてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 二条の后の、春宮のみやす所と申ける時に、御屏風に竜田川に紅葉なかれたるかたをかけりけるを題にてよめる
attributes.field_text: ちはやふる / 神代もきかす / 立田川 / から紅に / 水くくるとは
attributes.field_text_romaji: chihayaburu / kamiyo mo kikazu / Tatsutagawa / karakurenai ni / mizu kukuru towa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: chihayaburu / kamiyo mo kikazu / Tatsutagawa / karakurenai ni / mizu kukuru towa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'unheard of \teven/ in the stories of the age/ of the awesome gods  ̶  / the waters of Tatsuta/ Stream dyed with swirling red', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.131'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a571a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 神なひの山をすきてたつた川をわたりける時に、紅葉のなかれけるをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 神なひの山をすきてたつた川をわたりける時に、紅葉のなかれけるをよめる
attributes.field_text: 神なひの / 山を過行 / 秋なれは / 竜田川にそ / ぬさはたむくる
attributes.field_text_romaji: kamunabi no / yama o sugiyuku / aki nareba / Tatsutagawa ni zo / nusa wa tamukuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kamunabi no / yama o sugiyuku / aki nareba / Tatsutagawa ni zo / nusa wa tamukuru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'because autumn is/ returning \tcrossing over/ Kannabi Mountain/ she offers crimson prayer/ stripes at Tatsuta River', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.133'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a571b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: たつた河のほとりにてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: たつた河のほとりにてよめる
attributes.field_text: もみちはの / なかれさりせは / 立田川 / 水の秋をは / たれかしらまし
attributes.field_text_romaji: momijiba no / nagarezariseba / Tatsutagawa  / mizu no aki oba / tare ka shiramashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: momijiba no / nagarezariseba / Tatsutagawa  / mizu no aki oba / tare ka shiramashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'if no colored leaves/ drifted downstream there \twho would/ know that autumn had/  come to the clear waters/ of the Tatsuta River', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.133'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a571c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 寛平御時、ふるき歌たてまつれとおほせられけれは、／立田川／もみちはなかる／といふ歌をかきて、そのおなし心をよめりける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 寛平御時、ふるき歌たてまつれとおほせられけれは、／立田川／もみちはなかる／といふ歌をかきて、そのおなし心をよめりける
attributes.field_text: 深山より / おちくる水の / 色みてそ / 秋は限と / 思しりぬる
attributes.field_text_romaji: miyama yori / ochikuru mizu no / iro mite zo / aki wa kagiri to / omoi shirinuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: miyama yori / ochikuru mizu no / iro mite zo / aki wa kagiri to / omoi shirinuru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'seeing the color/ of the waters which tumble/ down the beautiful/ mountains \tI know full well that/ this autumn is at its end', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.135-136'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a571d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 秋のはつる心を、竜田川に思ひやりてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 秋のはつる心を、竜田川に思ひやりてよめる
attributes.field_text: としことに / 紅葉はなかす / 竜田川 / みなとや秋の / とまり成らん
attributes.field_text_romaji: toshi goto ni / momijiba nagasu / Tatsutagawa / minato ya aki no / tomari naruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: toshi goto ni / momijiba nagasu / Tatsutagawa / minato ya aki no / tomari naruran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'every year the/ Tatsuta River carries/ the colored leaves past  ̶  / is it that the river mouth/ is the berth of autumn', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.136'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a571e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 竜田川 / 錦をりかく / 神無月 / しくれの雨を / たてぬきにして
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / nishiki orikaku / Kannazuki / shigure no ame o / tate nuki ni shite
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / nishiki orikaku / Kannazuki / shigure no ame o / tate nuki ni shite
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'on the Tatsuta/ River the Godless Month weaves/ a brocade of leaves/ red and gold upon the sharp/ silver warp and weft of sleet', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.137'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a571f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: あやなくて / またきなき名の / 立田河 / わたらてやまん / 物ならなくに
attributes.field_text_romaji: ayanakute / madaki naki na no / Tatsutagawa / watara de yaman / mono nara naku ni
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ayanakute / madaki naki na no / Tatsutagawa / watara de yaman / mono nara naku ni
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'already rumors/ swirl \tthough as yet there is no/ truth to them \tcan I/ now refrain from venturing/ forth to ford Tatsuta’s course', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.230'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5720
attributes.field_text: 秋のゆふへ、竜田河になかるるもみちをは、みかとのおほんめに、錦とみたまひ、春のあした、よし野の山のさくらは、人まろか心には、雲かとのみなむおほえける。
attributes.field_text_romaji: aki no yūbe, Tatsutagawa ni nagaruru momiji oba, mikado no onme ni nishiki to mitamai, haru no ashita Yoshino no yama no sakura wa Hitomaro ga kokoro ni wa kumo ka to nomi namu oboekeru.
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: aki no yūbe, Tatsutagawa ni nagaruru momiji oba, mikado no onme ni nishiki to mitamai, haru no ashita Yoshino no yama no sakura wa Hitomaro ga kokoro ni wa kumo ka to nomi namu oboekeru.

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5721
attributes.field_text: 平城帝の御歌、竜田河紅葉乱れて流るめり錦中や絶えなむ。人麿、梅の花それとも見えずひさかたの天霧る行きの並べて降れれば、
attributes.field_text_romaji: "Nara no mikado no on-uta ""Tatsutagawa momiji midarete nagarumeri wataraba nishiki naka ya taenamu"".  Hitomaro ""mume no hana sore tomo miezu hisakata no amagiru yuki no nabete furereba""."
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: "Nara no mikado no on-uta ""Tatsutagawa momiji midarete nagarumeri wataraba nishiki naka ya taenamu"".  Hitomaro ""mume no hana sore tomo miezu hisakata no amagiru yuki no nabete furereba""."

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5722
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 仁和の中将のみやすん所の家に、歌合せんとてしける時によみける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 仁和の中将のみやすん所の家に、歌合せんとてしける時によみける
attributes.field_text: 花のちる / ことやわひしき / 春霞 / 立田の山の / 鶯のこゑ
attributes.field_text_romaji: hana no chiru / koto ya wabishiki / harugasumi / Tatsuta no yama no / uguisu no koe
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hana no chiru / koto ya wabishiki / harugasumi / Tatsuta no yama no / uguisu no koe
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'surely it is the/  falling of the blossoms that/  he mourns \tthe mountain/ thrush cries on Mount Tatsuta/ where spring mists drift skyward', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.79'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5723
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず　（左注）ある人、このうたは、むかし大和国なりける人のむすめに、ある人すみわたりける、この女、親もなく成て、家もわろく成行あひた、このおとこ、かうちの国に人をあひしりてかよひつつ、かれやうにのみ成ゆきけり、さりけれとも、つらけなるけしきもみえて、かうちへいくことに、男の心のことくにしつついたしやりけれは、あやしと思て、もしなきまにこと心もや有とうたかひて、月の面白かりける夜、かうちへいくまねにて、せんさいのなかにかくれてみけれは、夜ふくるまてことをかきならしつつ、打歎て、この歌を読てねにけれは、是をききて、それより又ほかへもまからす成にけりとなん、いひつたへたる
attributes.field_text: 風ふけは / おきつ白浪 / たつた山 / 夜半にや君か / ひとりこゆらん
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kaze fukeba / okitsu shiranami / Tatsutayama / yowa ni ya kimi ga / hitori koyuran

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5724
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: たかみそき / ゆふつけとりか / 唐衣 / たつたの山に / おりはへてなく
attributes.field_text_romaji: taga misogi / yūtsukedori ka / karakoromo / Tatsuta no yama ni / orihaete naku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: taga misogi / yūtsukedori ka / karakoromo / Tatsuta no yama ni / orihaete naku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'whose cock \tadorned with/ purification ribbons/ crows incessantly/ on bright Tatsuta Mountain/ colorful as Chinese robes', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.336'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5725
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 立田川 / 色くれなゐに / なりにけり / 山のもみちそ / いまはちるらし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / iro kurenai ni / narinikeri / yama no momiji zo / ima wa chirurashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / iro kurenai ni / narinikeri / yama no momiji zo / ima wa chirurashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The Tatsuta River/ I see has now changed into/ A scarlet color./ Apparently the mountain’s/ Autumn leaves have now fallen.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5726
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 竜田川 / 秋にしなれは / 山ちかみ / なかるる水も / もみちしにけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / aki ni shi nareba / yama chikami / nagaruru mizu mo / momiji shinikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / aki ni shi nareba / yama chikami / nagaruru mizu mo / momiji shinikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Tatsuta River/ When autumn season arrives/ Is close to mountains,/ So the flowing water, too,/ Changes color as the leaves.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5727
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 立田川 / 秋は水なく / あせななん / あかぬもみちの / なかるれはおし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / aki wa mizu naku / asenanan / akanu momiji no / nagarureba oshi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / aki wa mizu naku / asenanan / akanu momiji no / nagarureba oshi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Tatsuta river:/ How I whish that in autumn,/ The water would dry!/ I don’t want to see the leaves/ Float away from my vision.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5728
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 忍ひてすみ侍りける人のもとより、かかるけしき人にみすな、といへりけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 忍ひてすみ侍りける人のもとより、かかるけしき人にみすな、といへりけれは
attributes.field_text: 立田川 / たちなは君か / なをおしみ / いはせの杜の / いはしとそ思ふ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / tachinaba kimi ga / na o oshimi / Iwase no mori no / iwaji to zo omou
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / tachinaba kimi ga / na o oshimi / Iwase no mori no / iwaji to zo omou

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5729
attributes.field_kotobagaki: やまとにまかりけるついてに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: やまとにまかりけるついてに
attributes.field_text: かりかねの / 鳴つるなへに / から衣 / 立田の山は / もみちしにけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: karigane no / nakitsuru nae ni / karakoromo / Tatsuta no yama wa / momiji shinikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: karigane no / nakitsuru nae ni / karakoromo / Tatsuta no yama wa / momiji shinikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'As soon as the geese/ Cry on their return, just then,/ The Chinese clothing/ Tatsuta mountain is filled/ With the colored autumn leaves.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a572a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: いもかひも / とくとむすふと / 立田山 / いまそもみちの / 錦をりける
attributes.field_text_romaji: imo ga himo / toku to musubu to / Tatsutayama / ima zo momiji no / nishiki orikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: imo ga himo / toku to musubu to / Tatsutayama / ima zo momiji no / nishiki orikeru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'My lover’s robe cord/ Tied to release I set off/ On Mount Tatsuya/ Now the colored autumn leaves/ Have been woven as brocade.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a572b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: かり鳴て / さむきあしたの / 露ならし / 立田の山を / もみたすものは
attributes.field_text_romaji: kari naki te / samuki ashita no / tsuyu narashi / Tatsuta no yama o / momidasu mono wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kari naki te / samuki ashita no / tsuyu narashi / Tatsuta no yama o / momidasu mono wa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The geese are crying/ In the cold of the morning/ It seems there is dew/ Thus on Tatsuta Mountain/ The leaves are starting to change.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a572c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 立田山をこゆとて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 立田山をこゆとて
attributes.field_text: かくはかり / もみつるいろの / こけれはや / にしき立田の / 山といふらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: kaku bakari / momizuru iro no / kokereba ya / nishiki Tatsuta no / yama to iuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kaku bakari / momizuru iro no / kokereba ya / nishiki Tatsuta no / yama to iuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The coloring of/ The autumn leaves is so deep/ Perhaps that is why/ This mountain was given the name/ Brocade making Tatsuta.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a572d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: から錦 / 立田の山も / 今よりは / もみちなからに / ときはならなむ
attributes.field_text_romaji: karanishiki / Tatsuta no yama mo / ima yori wa / momiji nagara ni / tokiwa naranamu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: karanishiki / Tatsuta no yama mo / ima yori wa / momiji nagara ni / tokiwa naranamu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Of Chinese brocade/ Even Tatsuta Mountain/ If only, from now,/ The leaves could remain colored/ And stay for eternity.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a572e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: から衣 / 立田の山の / もみち葉は / はた物もなき / 錦なりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: karakoromo / Tatsuta no yama no / momijiba wa / hata mono mo naki / nishiki narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: karakoromo / Tatsuta no yama no / momijiba wa / hata mono mo naki / nishiki narikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Of Chinese clothing/ On Tatsuta Mountain/ The Leaves of autumn/ Though not woven with a loom/ The leaves are still a brocade.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a572f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: なとさらに / 秋かととはん / から錦 / 立田の山の / もみちするよを
attributes.field_text_romaji: nado sarani / aki ka to towan / karanishiki / Tatsuta no yama no / momiji suru yo o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: nado sarani / aki ka to towan / karanishiki / Tatsuta no yama no / momiji suru yo o
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Why ask, even now/ Whether this is now autumn?/ This is a world where/ Tatsuta Mountain is draped/ In a colored leaf brocade.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5730
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 奈良のみかと、竜田川に紅葉御覧しに行幸ありける御ともにつかうまつりて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 奈良のみかと、竜田川に紅葉御覧しに行幸ありける御ともにつかうまつりて
attributes.field_text: たつた川 / もみちはなかる / 神なひの / みむろの山に / しくれふるらし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / momijiba nagaru / kamunabi no / Mimuro no yama ni / shigure fururashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / momijiba nagaru / kamunabi no / Mimuro no yama ni / shigure fururashi

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5731
attributes.field_kotobagaki: むろの木
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: むろの木
attributes.field_text: 神なひの / みむろのきしや / くつるらん / たつたの川の / 水のにこれる
attributes.field_text_romaji: kamunabi no / Mimuro no kishi ya / kuzururan / Tatsuta no kawa no / mizu no nigoreru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kamunabi no / Mimuro no kishi ya / kuzururan / Tatsuta no kawa no / mizu no nigoreru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5732
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 秋は来ぬ / たつたの山も / みてしかな / しくれぬさきに / 色やかはると
attributes.field_text_romaji: aki wa kinu / Tatsuta no yama no / miteshigana / shigurenu saki ni / iro ya kawaru to
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: aki wa kinu / Tatsuta no yama no / miteshigana / shigurenu saki ni / iro ya kawaru to

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5733
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 廉義公家のかみゑに、たひ人のぬす人にあひたるかたかける所
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 廉義公家のかみゑに、たひ人のぬす人にあひたるかたかける所
attributes.field_text: ぬす人の / たつたの山に / 入にけり / おなしかさしの / 名にやけかれん
attributes.field_text_romaji: nusubito no / Tatsuta no yama ni / irinikeri / onaji kazashi no / na ni ya kegaren
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: nusubito no / Tatsuta no yama ni / irinikeri / onaji kazashi no / na ni ya kegaren

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5734
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 廉義公家のかみゑに、たひ人のぬす人にあひたるかたかける所
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 廉義公家のかみゑに、たひ人のぬす人にあひたるかたかける所
attributes.field_text: なき名のみ / たつたのやまの / ふもとには / 世にもあらしの / 風もふかなむ
attributes.field_text_romaji: naki na nomi / Tatsuta no yama no / fumoto ni wa / yo ni mo arashi no / kaze mo fukanamu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: naki na nomi / Tatsuta no yama no / fumoto ni wa / yo ni mo arashi no / kaze mo fukanamu

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5735
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: なき名のみ / たつたの山の / あをつつら / 又くる人も / みえぬ所に
attributes.field_text_romaji: naki na nomi / Tatsuta no yama no / aotsuzura / mata kuru hito mo / mienu tokoro ni
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: naki na nomi / Tatsuta no yama no / aotsuzura / mata kuru hito mo / mienu tokoro ni

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5736
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 正子内親王のゑあはせし侍けるに、かねのさうしにかき侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 正子内親王のゑあはせし侍けるに、かねのさうしにかき侍ける
attributes.field_text: うの花の / さけるかきねは / 白浪の / 立田の川の / ゐせきとそみる
attributes.field_text_romaji: unohana no / sakeru kakine wa / shiranami no / Tatsuta no kawa no / iseki to zo miru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: unohana no / sakeru kakine wa / shiranami no / Tatsuta no kawa no / iseki to zo miru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5737
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 夏衣 / 立田河原の / 柳かけ / すすみにきつつ / ならす比かな
attributes.field_text_romaji: natsugoromo / Tatsutagawara no / yanagikage / suzumi ni kitsutsu / narasu koro kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: natsugoromo / Tatsutagawara no / yanagikage / suzumi ni kitsutsu / narasu koro kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'They should be now accustomed, that in summer clothes we come again and again to the shades of the willows in the riverbed of Tatsuta river', 'source': ''}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5738
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 永承四年内裏歌合によめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 永承四年内裏歌合によめる
attributes.field_text: 嵐吹 / みむろの山の / もみちはは / 立田の川の / にしきなりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: arashi fuku / mimuro no yama no / momijiba wa / Tatsuta no kawa no / nishiki narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: arashi fuku / mimuro no yama no / momijiba wa / Tatsuta no kawa no / nishiki narikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The winds of a storm/ blowing on Mount Mimuro/ have brought autumn leaves/ down to Tatsuta River  ̶  / and made it a rich brocade.', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.228'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5739
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 実行卿の家の歌合に霞の心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 実行卿の家の歌合に霞の心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 年毎に / かはらぬ物は / 春かすみ / たつたの山の / けしきなりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: toshi goto ni / kawaranu mono wa / harugasumi / Tatsuta no yama no / keshiki narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: toshi goto ni / kawaranu mono wa / harugasumi / Tatsuta no yama no / keshiki narikeri

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a573a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 落葉をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 落葉をよめる
attributes.field_text: 谷川に / しからみかけよ / 立田ひめ / みねのもみちに / あらし吹なり
attributes.field_text_romaji: tanigawa ni / shigarami kakeyo / Tatsutahime / mine no momiji ni / arashi fukunari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: tanigawa ni / shigarami kakeyo / Tatsutahime / mine no momiji ni / arashi fukunari

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a573b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 後朱雀院御時、御前にて霧蔵紅葉といへることをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 後朱雀院御時、御前にて霧蔵紅葉といへることをよめる
attributes.field_text: もみちちる / 山は秋きり / 晴せねは / 立田の河の / なかれをそみる
attributes.field_text_romaji: momiji chiru / yama wa akigiri / hareseneba / Tatsuta no kawa no / nagare o zo miru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: momiji chiru / yama wa akigiri / hareseneba / Tatsuta no kawa no / nagare o zo miru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a573c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌のなかにもみちをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌のなかにもみちをよめる
attributes.field_text: 立田川 / しからみかけて / 神なひの / みむろの山の / もみちをそみる
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / shigarami kakete / kamunabi no / mimuro no yama no / momiji o zo miru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / shigarami kakete / kamunabi no / mimuro no yama no / momiji o zo miru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a573d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首の歌奉りける時、よめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首の歌奉りける時、よめる
attributes.field_text: 立田山 / 松のむら立 / なかりせは / いつくか残る / 緑ならまし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutayama / matsu no muradachi / nakariseba / izuku ka nokoru / midori naramashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutayama / matsu no muradachi / nakariseba / izuku ka nokoru / midori naramashi

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a573e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 落葉の心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 落葉の心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 立田山 / ふもとのさとは / 遠けれと / 嵐のつてに / 紅葉をそみる
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutayama / fumoto no sato wa / tōkeredo / arashi no tsute ni / momiji o zo miru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutayama / fumoto no sato wa / tōkeredo / arashi no tsute ni / momiji o zo miru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a573f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 承暦二年内裏の歌合に、紅葉をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 承暦二年内裏の歌合に、紅葉をよめる
attributes.field_text: 立田山 / 散もみちはを / きてみれは / 秋はふもとに / 帰るなりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutayama / chiru momijiba o / kite mireba / aki wa fumoto ni / kaeru narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutayama / chiru momijiba o / kite mireba / aki wa fumoto ni / kaeru narikeri

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5740
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 二条院の御時、こいたしきといふ五字を句の上に置て旅の心を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 二条院の御時、こいたしきといふ五字を句の上に置て旅の心を
attributes.field_text: 駒なへて / いさ見にゆかむ / 立田川 / 白浪よする / 岸のあたりを
attributes.field_text_romaji: koma nabete / iza mi ni yukamu / Tatsutagawa / shiranami yosuru / kishi no atari o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: koma nabete / iza mi ni yukamu / Tatsutagawa / shiranami yosuru / kishi no atari o

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5741
attributes.field_text: 春霞立田の山に初花をしのぶより、夏は妻恋ひする神なびの郭公、秋は風に散る葛城の紅葉、冬は白たへの富士の高嶺に雪つもる年の暮れまで、みなおりにふれたる情なるべし
attributes.field_text_romaji: harugasumi Tatsuta no yama ni hatsuhana o shinobu yori, natsu wa tsumagoi suru kamunabi no hototogisu, aki wa kaze ni chiru Kazuraki no momiji, fuyu wa shirotae no Fuji no takane ni yuki tsumoru toshi no kure made, mina ori ni furetaru nasake narubeshi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: harugasumi Tatsuta no yama ni hatsuhana o shinobu yori, natsu wa tsumagoi suru kamunabi no hototogisu, aki wa kaze ni chiru Kazuraki no momiji, fuyu wa shirotae no Fuji no takane ni yuki tsumoru toshi no kure made, mina ori ni furetaru nasake narubeshi

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5742
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: ゆかむ人 / 来ん人しのへ / 春かすみ / 立田の山の / はつさくら花
attributes.field_text_romaji: yukamu hito / kon hito shinobe / harugasumi / Tatsuta no yama no / hatsusakurabana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yukamu hito / kon hito shinobe / harugasumi / Tatsuta no yama no / hatsusakurabana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'all you who go and/ all you who come must yearn now  ̶  / for warm spring mists/ rise to hide those first cherry/ blossoms on Mount Tatsuta', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.40'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5743
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 和歌所にて歌つかふまつりしに、春歌とてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 和歌所にて歌つかふまつりしに、春歌とてよめる
attributes.field_text: かつらきや / たかまの桜 / さきにけり / 立田のおくに / かかる白雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: Kazuraki ya / Takama no sakura / sakinikeri / Tatsuta no oku ni / kakaru shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Kazuraki ya / Takama no sakura / sakinikeri / Tatsuta no oku ni / kakaru shirakumo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'ah Kazuraki/ on the peak of Takama/ cherries have blossomed/ in the depths of Tatsuta/ white clouds cling to the summit', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.41'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5744
attributes.field_kotobagaki: やへさくらをおりて人のつかはして侍けれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: やへさくらをおりて人のつかはして侍けれは
attributes.field_text: しら雲の / 立田の山の / 八重桜 / いつれを花と / わきておりけん
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirakumo no / Tatsuta no yama no / yaezakura / izure o hana to / wakite oriken
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirakumo no / Tatsuta no yama no / yaezakura / izure o hana to / wakite oriken
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'white clouds drift across/ the peaks of Mount Tatsuta/ where eight-fold cherries/ bloom \tdid you descry which were/ blossoms and pluck them for me', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.42'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5745
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: 白雲の / 春はかさねて / 立田山 / をくらの嶺に / はな匂ふらし
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirakumo no / haru wa kasanete / Tatsutayama / Ogura no mine ni / hana niourashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirakumo no / haru wa kasanete / Tatsutayama / Ogura no mine ni / hana niourashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'spring \tseason of white/ clouds \tlayers of new billows/ drift on Tatsuta/ Mountain \tsurely the blossoms/ dazzle on Ogura Peak', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.43'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5746
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 中納言中将に侍ける時家に、山家早秋といへるこころをよませ侍けるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 中納言中将に侍ける時家に、山家早秋といへるこころをよませ侍けるに
attributes.field_text: 朝霧や / 立田の山の / 里ならて / 秋きにけりと / 誰かしらまし
attributes.field_text_romaji: asagiri ya / Tatsuta no yama no / sato narade / aki kinikeri to / tare ka shiramashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: asagiri ya / Tatsuta no yama no / sato narade / aki kinikeri to / tare ka shiramashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'those who do not dwell/ here in this village near/ Tatsuta Mountain/ where chill morning mists rise \twhich/ of them could know autumn has come', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.134'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5747
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 立田山 / 夜はにあらしの / 松ふけは / 雲にはうとき / みねの月影
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutayama / yowa ni arashi no / matsu fukeba / kumo ni wa utoki / mine no tsukikage
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutayama / yowa ni arashi no / matsu fukeba / kumo ni wa utoki / mine no tsukikage
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Tatsuta Mountain/ passing storms in the deep of/ night blow through the pines/ the clinging clouds have dispersed/ moonlight floods the peak they cloaked', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.177'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5748
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 竜田山 / 木すゑまはらに / 成ままに / ふかくも鹿の / そよくなる哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutayama / kozue mabara ni / naru mama ni / fukaku mo shika no / soyogu naru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutayama / kozue mabara ni / naru mama ni / fukaku mo shika no / soyogu naru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as the tree tops thin/ growing ever sparser on/ Tatsuta Mountain/ the deer moving deeper into/ the highlands rustle through dry leaves', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.193'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5749
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 入道前関白太政大臣家に百首歌よみ侍けるに、もみちを
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 入道前関白太政大臣家に百首歌よみ侍けるに、もみちを
attributes.field_text: 心もや / もみちはすらん / たつた山 / 松は時雨に / ぬれぬ物かは
attributes.field_text_romaji: kokoro mo ya / momiji wa suran / Tatsutayama / matsu wa shigure ni / nurenu mono kawa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kokoro mo ya / momiji wa suran / Tatsutayama / matsu wa shigure ni / nurenu mono kawa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Is it in the heart/ of the leaves to change colors?/ Why else could it be/ that the pines at Tatsuta/ are never dyed by showers?', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.188'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a574a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: 立田河 / あらしや嶺に / よはる覧 / わたらぬ水も / にしきたえけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutagawa / arashi ya mine ni / yowaruran / wataranu mizu mo / nishiki taekeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutagawa / arashi ya mine ni / yowaruran / wataranu mizu mo / nishiki taekeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Are the storm winds/ Losing strength up on your peak,/ Mount Tatsuta?/ That never-crossed brocade bridge/ Seems to have drifted away.', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.189'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a574b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 五十首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 五十首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: からにしき / 秋の形見や / 立田山 / 散あへぬ枝に / あらし吹なり
attributes.field_text_romaji: karanishiki / aki no katami ya / Tatsutayama / chiriaenu eda ni / arashi fukunari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: karanishiki / aki no katami ya / Tatsutayama / chiriaenu eda ni / arashi fukunari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'bright Chinese brocade  ̶  / is it to tear away this/ last autumn keepsake/ from Mount Tatsuta that storms/ buffet the unyielding boughs', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.237'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a574c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 詩を歌に合はせ侍しに、山路秋行といへるにとを
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 詩を歌に合はせ侍しに、山路秋行といへるにとを
attributes.field_text: たつた山 / 秋行人の / 袖を見よ / 木々のこすゑは / しくれさりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tatsutayama / aki yuku hito no / sode o miyo / kigi no kozue wa / shigurezarikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tatsutayama / aki yuku hito no / sode o miyo / kigi no kozue wa / shigurezarikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Tatsuta Mountain/ see these bright sleeves of passing/ autumn travelers/ when still the twigs and branches/ are unaffected by cold rains', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.404'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a574d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 名立恋といふ心をよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 名立恋といふ心をよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: なき名のみ / たつたの山に / たつ雲の / 行ゑもしらぬ / 詠をそする
attributes.field_text_romaji: naki na nomi / Tatsuta no yama ni / tatsu kumo no / yukue mo shiranu / nagame o zo suru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: naki na nomi / Tatsuta no yama ni / tatsu kumo no / yukue mo shiranu / nagame o zo suru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'baseless rumors rise/ like clouds drifting high above/ Tatsuta Mountain/ destination uncertain/ I gaze in sad reverie', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.467'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a574e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 秋されは / かり人こゆる / たつた山 / たちてもゐても / 物をしそ思ふ
attributes.field_text_romaji: aki sareba / karibito koyuru / Tatsutayama / tachite mo ite mo / mono o shi zo omou
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: aki sareba / karibito koyuru / Tatsutayama / tachite mo ite mo / mono o shi zo omou
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as autumn arrives/ the hunters approach \tacross/ Tatsuta Mountain/ while I \twhether standing or/ sitting \t\tam wrapped in sad thoughts', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.689'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a574f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 陸奥に / ありといふなる / 名とり川 / なきなとりては / くるしかりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Michinoku ni / ari to iu naru / Natorigawa / naki na torite wa / kurushikarikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Michinoku ni / ari to iu naru / Natorigawa / naki na torite wa / kurushikarikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'River of Rumors/ they say that you flow through far/ Michinoku \thow/ painful to know that we must/ suffer from these false whispers', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.229'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5750
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: なとり川 / せせのむもれ木 / 顕れは / いかにせんとか / あひみそめけん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Natorigawa / seze no mumoregi / arawareba / ikani sen toka / aimisomeken
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Natorigawa / seze no mumoregi / arawareba / ikani sen toka / aimisomeken
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'when I began to/ love you \twhat did I intend/ to do \tif hidden/ logs floated to the surface/ in Rumor River’s shallows', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.236'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5751
attributes.field_kotobagaki: （題しらず）（左注）このうた、ある人、あめのみかとの、あふみのうねめにたまへると
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: （題しらず）（左注）このうた、ある人、あめのみかとの、あふみのうねめにたまへると
attributes.field_text: いぬかみの / とこの山なる / ＊なとり川 / いさとこたへよ / わかなもらすな / ＊３いさや川イ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Inukami no / Tokonoyama naru / Natorigawa / iza to kotaeyo / wa ga na morasu na
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Inukami no / Tokonoyama naru / Natorigawa / iza to kotaeyo / wa ga na morasu na
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Name-taking River/ of Tokono Mountain in/ Inukami \tplease/ answer that you do not know  ̶  /do not let my name leak out', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.377'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5752
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 無名たてける人のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 無名たてける人のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: あさましや / あふせもしらぬ / 名とり川 / またきに岩ま / ＊もらすへしやは / ＊５もらすへしとはイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: asamashi ya / ause mo shiranu / Natorigawa / madaki ni iwama / morasubeshi yawa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: asamashi ya / ause mo shiranu / Natorigawa / madaki ni iwama / morasubeshi yawa

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5753
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 名とり川 / やなせの浪も / さはく成 / 紅葉やいとと / よりてせくらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Natorigawa / yanase no nami mo / sawagu nari / momiji ya itodo / yorite sekuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Natorigawa / yanase no nami mo / sawagu nari / momiji ya itodo / yorite sekuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Natori River/ swirling waves above the weir/ clamor more wildly  ̶  / have the swelling drifts of bright/ autumn leaves damned up the stream', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.232-233'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5754
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 摂政太政大臣家歌合によみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 摂政太政大臣家歌合によみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: ありとても / あはぬためしの / 名取川 / ＊朽たにはてね / 瀬瀬の埋木 / ＊４朽たにはてぬイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: ari tote mo / awanu tameshi no / Natorigawa / kuchi dani hatene / seze no umoregi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ari tote mo / awanu tameshi no / Natorigawa / kuchi dani hatene / seze no umoregi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'still alive \tno hope/ of meeting \tan example/ I’ve become to all  ̶  /oh \tto rot away like logs/ in Rumor River’s shallows', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.460'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5755
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_text: なけかすよ / 今はたおなし / 名取川 / 瀬瀬の埋木 / くちはてぬとも
attributes.field_text_romaji: nagekazu yo / ima hata onaji / Natorigawa / seze no umoregi / kuchihatenu tomo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: nagekazu yo / ima hata onaji / Natorigawa / seze no umoregi / kuchihatenu tomo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'no reason to grieve/ now it’s all the same to me/ as Rumor River/ rises \tbeneath its currents/ hidden logs will rot away', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.461'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5756
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 津の国の / 難波のあしの / めもはるに / しけきわか恋 / 人しるらめや
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tsu no kuni no / Naniwa no ashi no / me mo haru ni / shigeki waga koi / hito shirurame ya
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tsu no kuni no / Naniwa no ashi no / me mo haru ni / shigeki waga koi / hito shirurame ya
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'my love swells like the/ buds on the reeds that grow far/ into the distance/ on Naniwa shore in Tsu/ but can my beloved know', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.222'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5757
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 君か名も / わかなもたてし / なにはなる / みつともいふな / あひき共いはし
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi ga na mo / waga na mo tateji / naniwa naru / mitsu tomo iu na / aiki tomo iwaji
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi ga na mo / waga na mo tateji / naniwa naru / mitsu tomo iu na / aiki tomo iwaji
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Naniwa in Tsu/ will never hear your name or/ mine on the tongues of/ others \tdo not tell that we’ve/ met \tand I shall never speak', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.235'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5758
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 津の国の / なには思はす / 山しろの / とはにあひみん / ことをのみこそ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tsu no kuni no / Naniwa omowazu / Yamashiro no / towa ni aimin / koto o nomi koso
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tsu no kuni no / Naniwa omowazu / Yamashiro no / towa ni aimin / koto o nomi koso
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'oh Naniwa in/ Tsu Province \tI know not what/ to think \tfor here in/ Towa in Yamashiro/ I dream \talways \tof meeting', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.249'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5759
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: をしてるや / なにはのみつに / 焼塩の / からくも我は / 老にける哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: oshiteru ya / Naniwa no mitsu ni / yaku shio no / karaku mo ware wa / oinikeru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: oshiteru ya / Naniwa no mitsu ni / yaku shio no / karaku mo ware wa / oinikeru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as salty as the/ seaweed burned in Naniwa/ in beautiful Tsu/ are the bitter tears I shed/ so many years have I lived', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.306'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a575a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: なにはにまかれりける時よめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: なにはにまかれりける時よめる
attributes.field_text: 難波かた / おふる玉もを / かりそめの / あまとそ我は / 成ぬへら也
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwagata / ouru tamamo o / karisome no / ama to zo ware wa / narinuberanari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwagata / ouru tamamo o / karisome no / ama to zo ware wa / narinuberanari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'for a while \tit seems/ a fisherman I must be/ reaping the harvest/ of jeweled seaweed that grows/  deep beneath Naniwa Bay', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.313'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a575b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: なにはへまかりける時、たみのゝしまにて雨にあひてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: なにはへまかりける時、たみのゝしまにて雨にあひてよめる
attributes.field_text: 雨により / たみのゝしまを / けふゆけは / なにはかくれぬ / 物にそ有ける
attributes.field_text_romaji: ame ni yori / tamino no shima o / kyō yukeba / Naniwa kakurenu / mono ni zo arikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ame ni yori / tamino no shima o / kyō yukeba / Naniwa kakurenu / mono ni zo arikeru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'caught in the rain \tI/ went today to Tamino/ Island \tbut I/ found no shelter in its name  ̶  / straw raincoat of the rice fields', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.313'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a575c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 我を君 / なにはのうらに / 有しかは / うきめをみつの / あまと成にき
attributes.field_text_romaji: ware o kimi / Naniwa no ura ni / arishikaba / uki me o mitsu no / ama to nariniki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ware o kimi / Naniwa no ura ni / arishikaba / uki me o mitsu no / ama to nariniki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'at Naniwa Bay/ you scorned me \tmy lord \tand in/ sorrow I drifted/ to Mitsu Temple \twhere the/ fisherfolk gather seaweed', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.329'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a575d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 難波なる / なからの橋も / つくる也 / 今は我身を / なにゝたとへん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwa naru / Nagara no hashi mo / tsukurunari / ima wa wagami o / nani ni tatoen
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwa naru / Nagara no hashi mo / tsukurunari / ima wa wagami o / nani ni tatoen
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'they say the bridge of/ Nagara in Naniwa/ will be repaired \tand/  then \tto what shall I compare/ this time-worn body of mine', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.359'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a575e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: なにはかた / 塩みちくらし / あま衣 / たみのゝ島に / たつ鳴わたる
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwagata / shio michikurashi / amagoromo / Tamino no shima ni / tazu nakiwataru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwagata / shio michikurashi / amagoromo / Tamino no shima ni / tazu nakiwataru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'it seems the tide is/ now flooding in Naniwa/ Bay \tcrying \tthe cranes/ fly toward Tamino Isle/ seeking fields of straw rain-cloaks', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.312'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a575f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 平定文か許より、なにはのかたへなんまかる、といひをくりて侍りけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 平定文か許より、なにはのかたへなんまかる、といひをくりて侍りけれは
attributes.field_text: 浦わかす / みるめかるてふ / あまの身は / なにか難波の / かたへしもゆく
attributes.field_text_romaji: ura wakazu / mirume karu chō / ama no mi wa / nanika Naniwa no / kata e shimo yuku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ura wakazu / mirume karu chō / ama no mi wa / nanika Naniwa no / kata e shimo yuku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'In every bay/ said to harvest seaweed/ the saltworker/ For what reason/ Do they go specially to Naniwa?', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5760
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 津のくにの / なにはたゝまく / おしみこそ / すくもたくひの / 下にこかるれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tsu no kuni no / Naniwa tatamaku / oshimi koso / sukumo taku hi no / shita ni kogarure
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tsu no kuni no / Naniwa tatamaku / oshimi koso / sukumo taku hi no / shita ni kogarure

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5761
attributes.field_kotobagaki: しのひてまかりけれとあはさりけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: しのひてまかりけれとあはさりけれは
attributes.field_text: なにはめに / みつとはなしに / 芦のねの / よのみしかくて / 明る侘しさ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwame ni / mitsu to wa nashi ni / ashi no ne no / yo no mijikakute / akuru wabishisa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwame ni / mitsu to wa nashi ni / ashi no ne no / yo no mijikakute / akuru wabishisa

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5762
attributes.field_kotobagaki: いと忍てまてきたりけるおとこをせいしける人ありけり、のゝしりけれはかへりまかりてつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: いと忍てまてきたりけるおとこをせいしける人ありけり、のゝしりけれはかへりまかりてつかはしける
attributes.field_text: あさりする / 時そわひしき / 人しれす / なにはの浦に / すまふ我身は
attributes.field_text_romaji: asari suru / toki zo wabishiki / hito shirezu / Naniwa no ura ni / sumau waga mi wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: asari suru / toki zo wabishiki / hito shirezu / Naniwa no ura ni / sumau waga mi wa

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5763
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 忍ひたる人に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 忍ひたる人に
attributes.field_text: 人ことの / たのみかたさは / 難波なる / 芦のうらはの / うらみつへしな
attributes.field_text_romaji: hito goto no / tanomigatasa wa / Naniwa naru / ashi no urawa no / uramitsubeshi na
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hito goto no / tanomigatasa wa / Naniwa naru / ashi no urawa no / uramitsubeshi na

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5764
attributes.field_kotobagaki: こといてきてのちに京極御息所につかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: こといてきてのちに京極御息所につかはしける
attributes.field_text: 侘ぬれは / 今はたおなし / 難波なる / みをつくしても / あはんとそ思
attributes.field_text_romaji: wabinureba / ima hata onaji / Naniwa naru / mio tsukushite mo / awan to zo omou
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: wabinureba / ima hata onaji / Naniwa naru / mio tsukushite mo / awan to zo omou
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Like a channel buoy/  bobbing off Naniwa strand,/ my name is tossed about./ But still I will come to you  ̶  / Though it be death to proceed.', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.211'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5765
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ふみなとつかはしける女の、ことおとこにつき侍りけるにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ふみなとつかはしける女の、ことおとこにつき侍りけるにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: 我ならぬ / 人すみのえの / きしに出て / なにはのかたを / 恨つるかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: ware naranu / hito Suminoe no / kishi ni idete / Naniwa no kata o / uramitsuru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ware naranu / hito Suminoe no / kishi ni idete / Naniwa no kata o / uramitsuru kana

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5766
attributes.field_kotobagaki: たいしらす
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: たいしらす
attributes.field_text: 人なみに / あらぬ我身は / 難波なる / 芦のねのみそ / したになかるゝ
attributes.field_text_romaji: hitonami  ni / aranu wagami wa / Naniwa naru / ashi no ne nomi zo / shita ni nagaruru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hitonami  ni / aranu wagami wa / Naniwa naru / ashi no ne nomi zo / shita ni nagaruru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5767
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 人のむすめに名たち侍て
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 人のむすめに名たち侍て
attributes.field_text: 世中を / しらすなからも / 津のくにの / なには立ぬる / 物にそありける
attributes.field_text_romaji: yononaka o / shirazu nagara mo / Tsu no kuni no / na ni wa tachinuru / mono ni zo arikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yononaka o / shirazu nagara mo / Tsu no kuni no / na ni wa tachinuru / mono ni zo arikeru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5768
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 遠きところにまかりけるみちより、やむことなき事によりて京へ人つかはしけるつゐてに、ふみのはしにかきつけ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 遠きところにまかりけるみちより、やむことなき事によりて京へ人つかはしけるつゐてに、ふみのはしにかきつけ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 我ことや / 君もこふらん / 白露の / おきてもねても / ＊袖そかはかぬ / ＊５袖のかはかぬイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga goto ya / kimi mo kouran / shiratsuyu no / okite mo nete mo / sode zo kawakanu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga goto ya / kimi mo kouran / shiratsuyu no / okite mo nete mo / sode zo kawakanu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Just like I [long for you]/  do you also long [for me]?/  The white dew/  settles, waking or sleeping/  my sleeves are not dry.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5769
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 女ともたちのもとに、つくしよりさしくしを心さすとて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 女ともたちのもとに、つくしよりさしくしを心さすとて
attributes.field_text: なにはかた / なにゝもあらす / みをつくし / ふかき心の / しるしはかりそ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwagata / nani ni mo arazu / mi o tsukushi / fukaki kokoro no / shirushi bakari zo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwagata / nani ni mo arazu / mi o tsukushi / fukaki kokoro no / shirushi bakari zo

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a576a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: まかりかよひける女の心とけすのみみえ侍りけれは、とし月もへぬるをいまさへかゝる事、といひつかはしたりけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: まかりかよひける女の心とけすのみみえ侍りけれは、とし月もへぬるをいまさへかゝる事、といひつかはしたりけれは
attributes.field_text: 難波かた / 汀のあしの / 老かよに / 恨てそふる / 人の心を
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwagata / migiwa no ashi no / oi ga yo ni / uramite zo furu / hito no kokoro o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwagata / migiwa no ashi no / oi ga yo ni / uramite zo furu / hito no kokoro o

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a576b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 身のうれへ侍ける時、津のくにゝまかりてすみはしめ侍けるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 身のうれへ侍ける時、津のくにゝまかりてすみはしめ侍けるに

attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwame no / sukumo taku hi no / shita kogare / ue wa tsurenaki / wagami narikeri

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a578c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 摂政右大臣の時の家の歌合に、旅宿逢恋といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 摂政右大臣の時の家の歌合に、旅宿逢恋といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 難波江の / あしのかりねの / 一夜ゆへ / 身をつくしてや / 恋渡るへき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwae no / ashi no karine no / hitoyo yue / mi o tsukushite ya / koiwatarubeki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwae no / ashi no karine no / hitoyo yue / mi o tsukushite ya / koiwatarubeki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Because of one night  ̶  / brief as the space between joints/ on Naniwa’s reeds  ̶  / am I to be a buoy,/ tossed by waves of love?', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.233'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a578d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 眺望の心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 眺望の心をよめる
attributes.field_text: なにはかた / 塩路はるかに / 見渡せは / 霞にうかふ / 沖のつり舟
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwagata / shioji haruka ni / miwataseba / kasumi ni ukabu / oki no tsuribune
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwagata / shioji haruka ni / miwataseba / kasumi ni ukabu / oki no tsuribune

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a578e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 八月十五夜和歌所歌合に、海辺秋月といふことを
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 八月十五夜和歌所歌合に、海辺秋月といふことを
attributes.field_text: 忘しな / 難波の秋の / 夜はの空 / こと浦にすむ / 月はみるとも
attributes.field_text_romaji: wasureji na / Naniwa no aki no / yowa no sora / koto ura ni sumu / tsuki wa miru tomo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: wasureji na / Naniwa no aki no / yowa no sora / koto ura ni sumu / tsuki wa miru tomo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I’ll not forget it ̶  / the midnight sky in autumn/ over Naniwa/ even if I see the moon/ gleaming on another bay', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.173'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a578f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 津の国の / 難波の春は / 夢なれや / あしの枯葉に / 風わたるなり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tsunokuni no / Naniwa no haru wa / yume nare ya / ashi no kareha ni / kaze watarunari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tsunokuni no / Naniwa no haru wa / yume nare ya / ashi no kareha ni / kaze watarunari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'That spring long ago/ at Naniwa in Tsu  ̶  / was it all a dream?/ Now only dead leaves on the reeds/ rustle in the passing wind.', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.162'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5790
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大江嘉言つしまになりてくたるとて、なには堀江のあしのうら葉にとよみて下侍にけるほとに、国にてなくなりにけりときゝて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大江嘉言つしまになりてくたるとて、なには堀江のあしのうら葉にとよみて下侍にけるほとに、国にてなくなりにけりときゝて
attributes.field_text: あはれ人 / けふの命を / しらませは / なにはのあしに / 契らさらまし
attributes.field_text_romaji: aware hito / kyō no inochi o / shiramaseba / naniwa no ashi ni / chigirazaramashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: aware hito / kyō no inochi o / shiramaseba / naniwa no ashi ni / chigirazaramashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'ah \tpoor gentleman/ had you but known what your life’s/ fate would bring today/ surely you would not have made/ that vow to Naniwa reeds', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.339-340'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5791
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 入道前関白家百首歌に、旅のこゝろを
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 入道前関白家百首歌に、旅のこゝろを
attributes.field_text: 難波人 / あし火たく屋に / 宿かりて / すゝろに袖の / しほたるゝ哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwabito / ashibi taku ya ni / yado karite / suzuro ni sode no / shiotaruru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwabito / ashibi taku ya ni / yado karite / suzuro ni sode no / shiotaruru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'lodging in a hut/ where Naniwa fisherfolk/ light their smoky fires/ of reeds \theavy are the salt/ tears that drip upon my sleeves', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.399-400'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5792
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 我恋は / いはぬはかりそ / 難波なる / あしのしのやの / 下にこそたけ
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga koi wa / iwanu bakari zo / Naniwa naru / ashi no shinoya no / shita ni koso take
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga koi wa / iwanu bakari zo / Naniwa naru / ashi no shinoya no / shita ni koso take
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'why is it that I/ cannot speak my love aloud  ̶  / it burns within like/ the smoldering reed fires in/ bamboo huts in Naniwa', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.436'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5793
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 和歌所歌合に、忍恋をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 和歌所歌合に、忍恋をよめる
attributes.field_text: 難波人 / いかなるえにか / 朽はてん / あふことなみに / 身をつくしつゝ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwabito / ikanaru e ni ka / kuchi haten / au koto nami ni / mi o tsukushitsutsu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwabito / ikanaru e ni ka / kuchi haten / au koto nami ni / mi o tsukushitsutsu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Naniwa seafolk/ in what bay must I waste and/ die \twhat connection/ to my past keeps us apart/ channel markers in the waves', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.441-442'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5794
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: なにはめの / 衣ほすとて / かりてたく / 芦火の煙 / 絶ぬ日そなき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwame no / koromo hosu tote / karite taku / ashibi no keburi / taenu hi zo naki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwame no / koromo hosu tote / karite taku / ashibi no keburi / taenu hi zo naki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'never does a day/ pass when smoke does not rise from/ the reeds cut and burned/ to dry the soaked garments of/ the women of Naniwa', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.652'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5795
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 難波のみつの寺にて、あしの葉のそよくをきゝて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 難波のみつの寺にて、あしの葉のそよくをきゝて
attributes.field_text: あしそよく / しほ瀬の浪の / いつ迄か / 浮世中に / うかひわたらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: ashi soyogu / shiose no nami no / itsu made ka / uki yononaka ni / ukabi wataran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ashi soyogu / shiose no nami no / itsu made ka / uki yononaka ni / ukabi wataran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'like briny waves that/ set the reeds to whispering/ along the shore \thow/ long will I go on floating/ through this sad inconstant world', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.780'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5796
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 詩を作らせて歌にあわせ侍しに、水郷春望といふことを
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 詩を作らせて歌にあわせ侍しに、水郷春望といふことを
attributes.field_text: 夕月夜 / しほみちくらし / 難波江の / あしのわか葉を / こゆる白浪
attributes.field_text_romaji: yūzukuyo / shio michi kurashi / Naniwae no / ashi no wakaba o / koyuru shiranami
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yūzukuyo / shio michi kurashi / Naniwae no / ashi no wakaba o / koyuru shiranami
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Evening of a new moon  ̶  / the tide must be rising/ in the Bay of Naniwa:/ over the young shoots of reeds/ crests of white waves.', 'source': 'Shirane (2007): p.612'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5797
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 崇徳院に十首歌たてまつりける時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 崇徳院に十首歌たてまつりける時
attributes.field_text: 冬ふかく / 成にけらしな / 難波江の / 青葉ましらぬ / あしのむら立
attributes.field_text_romaji: fuyu fukaku / narinikerashi na / Naniwae no / aoba majiranu / ashi no muradachi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: fuyu fukaku / narinikerashi na / Naniwae no / aoba majiranu / ashi no muradachi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'inexorably/ the world fades into winter/ at Naniwa Bay/ no verdant leaf is mingled/ with the scattered stands of reeds', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.259'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5798
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: 難波かた / かすまぬ浪も / 霞けり / うつるもくもる / 朧月夜に
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwagata / kasumanu nami mo / kasumikeri / utsuru mo kumoru / oborozukuyo ni
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwagata / kasumanu nami mo / kasumikeri / utsuru mo kumoru / oborozukuyo ni
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'at Naniwa Bay/ even the waves are hidden/ in soft spring haze \tyet/ a gentle light shimmers in/ the waters \tmisty moon-lit night', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.27'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a5799
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 難波かた / みしかきあしの / ふしのまも / あはて此世を / 過してよとや
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwagata / mijikaki ashi no / fushi no ma mo / awa de kono yo o / sugushite yo toya
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwagata / mijikaki ashi no / fushi no ma mo / awa de kono yo o / sugushite yo toya
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'What are you saying?/ That I cannot meet you  ̶  / not even for a time/ brief as the space between joints/ on the reeds at Naniwa?', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.211'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a579a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 難波かた / しほひにあさる / あしたつも / 月かたふけは / 声の恨る
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwagata / shiohi ni asaru / ashitazu mo / tsuki katabukeba / koe no uramuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwagata / shiohi ni asaru / ashitazu mo / tsuki katabukeba / koe no uramuru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'at Naniwa Bay/ the long-legged cranes searching/ the sands at ebb-tide/ offer their cries of protest/ as the moon sinks in the sky', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.637'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a579b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: おきつ風 / 夜はに吹らし / なにはかた / 暁かけて / 浪そよすなる
attributes.field_text_romaji: okitsukaze / yowa ni fukurashi / Naniwagata / akatsuki kakete / nami zo yosunaru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: okitsukaze / yowa ni fukurashi / Naniwagata / akatsuki kakete / nami zo yosunaru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'through the night \tit seems/ the winds blew in the offing/ at Naniwa Bay/ the waves crashing on the shore/ echoed until daybreak came', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.653'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a579c
attributes.field_text: 斟難波津之遺流、尋浅香山之芳躅、或吟或詠、抜犀象之牙角、無党無偏、採翡翠之羽毛 (難波津の遺流を斟み、浅香山の芳躅を尋ね、或いは吟じ或いは詠じ、犀象の牙角を抜き、党すること無く偏ること無く、翡翠の羽毛を採る)
attributes.field_text_romaji: Naniwazu no iryū o kumi, Asakayama no hōchoku o tazune, aruiwa ginji aruiwa eiji, saizō no gakaku o nuki, tōsuru koto naku katayoru koto naku, hisui no umō o toru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Naniwazu no iryū o kumi, Asakayama no hōchoku o tazune, aruiwa ginji aruiwa eiji, saizō no gakaku o nuki, tōsuru koto naku katayoru koto naku, hisui no umō o toru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a579d
attributes.field_text: みとりのほら花かうはしきあした、玉のみきり風涼しきゆふへ、なには津のなかれをくみて、すみにこれるをさため、あさか山の跡をたつねて、ふかきあさきをわかてり
attributes.field_text_romaji: midori no hora hana kōbashiki ashita, tama no migiri kaze suzushiki yūbe, Naniwazu no nagare wo kumite, sumi nigoreru o sadame, Asakayama no ato o tazunete fukaki asaki o wakateri.
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: midori no hora hana kōbashiki ashita, tama no migiri kaze suzushiki yūbe, Naniwazu no nagare wo kumite, sumi nigoreru o sadame, Asakayama no ato o tazunete fukaki asaki o wakateri.

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a579e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: つの国に侍けるころ、道済か許につかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: つの国に侍けるころ、道済か許につかはしける
attributes.field_text: 夏草の / かりそめにとて / こしかとも / 難波の浦に / 秋そ暮ぬる
attributes.field_text_romaji: natsukusa no / karisome ni tote / koshika domo / Naniwa no ura ni / aki zo kurenuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: natsukusa no / karisome ni tote / koshika domo / Naniwa no ura ni / aki zo kurenuru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'they were reaping summer/ grasses when first I came to/ live here \tfor just a while/ I thought \tyet somehow autumn/ has grown late at Naniwa Bay', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.230'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a579f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 天王寺にまいりけるに、なにはのうらにとまりてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 天王寺にまいりけるに、なにはのうらにとまりてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: さ夜ふけて / あしの末こす / 浦風に / あはれうちそふ / なみの音哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: sayo fukete / ashi no sue kosu / urakaze ni / aware uchi sou / nami no oto kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: sayo fukete / ashi no sue kosu / urakaze ni / aware uchi sou / nami no oto kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the fair night deepens/ and \trustling across the tips/ of the reeds \twinds from/ the bay add their sadness/ to the crashing of the waves', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.378'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 人しれぬ / 思ひを常に / するかなる / ふしの山こそ / わかみ成けれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: hito shirenu / omoi o tsune ni / Suruga naru / Fuji no yama koso / waga mi narikere
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hito shirenu / omoi o tsune ni / Suruga naru / Fuji no yama koso / waga mi narikere
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'like fiery Mount/ Fuji in Suruga \tmy/ yearning burns within  ̶ / an eternally smoldering/ passion my love can never know', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.202'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 君といへは / みまれみすまれ / ふしのねの / めつらしけなく / 崩るわか恋
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi to ieba / mi mare mizu mare / Fuji no ne no / mezurashige naku / kuzuru waga koi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi to ieba / mi mare mizu mare / Fuji no ne no / mezurashige naku / kuzuru waga koi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'whether alone or/ together \tyou \tmy love \tkeep/ my passion burning/  ceaselessly \tlike smoldering/  flames deep within Mount Fuji', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.245'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a3
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: ふしのねの / ならぬ思に / もえはもえ / 神たにけたぬ / むなし煙を
attributes.field_text_romaji: Fuji no ne no / naranu omoi ni / moe wa moe / kami dani ketanu / munashi keburi o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Fuji no ne no / naranu omoi ni / moe wa moe / kami dani ketanu / munashi keburi o
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'ah burn brightly then/ bitter fires of hopeless love/ hot as Fuji’s flames  ̶  / not even the gods would quench/ these unavailing smoke clouds', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.353'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a4
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 仮名序
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 仮名序
attributes.field_place_form: ふじのやま（ふじのけむり）
attributes.field_text: ふしの煙によそへて人をこひ松虫のねに友をしのひ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Fuji no keburi ni yosoete hito o koi matsumushi no ne ni tomo o shinobi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Fuji no keburi ni yosoete hito o koi matsumushi no ne ni tomo o shinobi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': '[…] he could compare his smoldering love to the smoke rising from Fuji, turn his thoughts to friends when he heard the voice of the pining cricket, […]', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.40'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 恋をのみ / つねにするかの / 山なれは / ふしのねにのみ / なかぬ日はなし
attributes.field_text_romaji: koi o nomi / tsune ni suruga no / yama nareba / Fuji no ne ni nomi / nakanu hi wa nashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: koi o nomi / tsune ni suruga no / yama nareba / Fuji no ne ni nomi / nakanu hi wa nashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Only longing/  I always do, Suruga/  Mountain, therefore/  Mount Fuji, only tears/  do I cry every day.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 我のみや / もえてきえなむ / よとともに / 思ひもならぬ / ふしのねのこと
attributes.field_text_romaji: ware nomi ya / moete kienamu / yo to tomo ni / omoi mo naranu / Fuji no ne no goto
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ware nomi ya / moete kienamu / yo to tomo ni / omoi mo naranu / Fuji no ne no goto
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Is it just me/  that will burn out and disappear?/  As long as the world lasts/  The fire of my thoughts does not become reality/  just like the peak of Mt. Fuji.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: ふしのねの / もえわたるとも / いかかせん / けちこそしらね / 水ならぬ身は
attributes.field_text_romaji: Fuji no ne no /moewataru tomo / ikaga sen / kechi koso shirane / mizu naranu mi wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Fuji no ne no /moewataru tomo / ikaga sen / kechi koso shirane / mizu naranu mi wa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Even if Mount Fuji continues to burn/  I can do nothing./  I do not know how to quench it/  my body not being water.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 思ひかけたる女のもとに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 思ひかけたる女のもとに
attributes.field_text: ふしのねを / よそにそききし / 今はわか / おもひにもゆる / 煙なりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Fuji no ne no / yoso ni zo kikishi / ima wa waga / omoi ni moyuru / keburi narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Fuji no ne no / yoso ni zo kikishi / ima wa waga / omoi ni moyuru / keburi narikeri

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57a9
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: しるしなき / 思ひとそきく / ふしのねも / かことはかりの / 煙なるらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirushi naki / omoi tozo kiku / Fuji no ne mo / kagoto bakari no / keburi naruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirushi naki / omoi tozo kiku / Fuji no ne mo / kagoto bakari no / keburi naruran

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57aa
attributes.field_kotobagaki: しなのへまかりける人に、たきものつかはすとて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: しなのへまかりける人に、たきものつかはすとて
attributes.field_text: しなのなる / あさまの山も / もゆなれは / ふしのけふりの / かひやなからん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Shinano naru / Asama no yama mo / moyu nareba / Fuji no keburi no / kai ya nakaran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Shinano naru / Asama no yama mo / moyu nareba / Fuji no keburi no / kai ya nakaran
attributes.field_volume: 巻第十九　離別　羈旅

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57ab
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 千早振 / 神もおもひの / あれはこそ / 年へてふしの / 山ももゆらめ
attributes.field_text_romaji: chihayabiru / kami mo omoi no / areba koso / toshi hete Fuji no / yama mo moyurame
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: chihayabiru / kami mo omoi no / areba koso / toshi hete Fuji no / yama mo moyurame
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The furious gods/ Also know the flames of love:/ Must it not be so,/ That across the endless years/ The mountain Fuji burns?', 'source': 'Cranston (1993): p.257'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57ac
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ふしの山のかたをつくらせ給て、ふちつほの御かたへつかはす
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ふしの山のかたをつくらせ給て、ふちつほの御かたへつかはす
attributes.field_text: 世の人の / をよはぬ物は / ふしのねの / 雲ゐにたかき / 思ひなりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: yo no hito no / oyobanu mono wa / Fuji no ne no / kumoi ni takaki / omoi narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yo no hito no / oyobanu mono wa / Fuji no ne no / kumoi ni takaki / omoi narikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'A man of the mundane world/ Can never reach so far:/ Around the peak of Fuji/ The clouds rise higher/ As does my passion for you.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57ad
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 永承四年内裏歌合によめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 永承四年内裏歌合によめる
attributes.field_text: いつとなく / 心空なる / わか恋や / ふしのたかねに / かかるしら雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: itsu to naku / kokoro sora naru / waga koi ya / Fuji no takane ni / kakaru shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: itsu to naku / kokoro sora naru / waga koi ya / Fuji no takane ni / kakaru shirakumo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Before I know it/ In my heart, sky-bound/ Is my love/ Above the high peak of Fuji/ Hanging with the clouds so white?', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57ae
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 日くらしに / 山ちのきのふ / しくれしは / ふしのたかねの / 雪にそありける
attributes.field_text_romaji: higurashi ni / yamaji no kinō / shigureshi wa / Fuji no takane no / yuki ni zo arikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: higurashi ni / yamaji no kinō / shigureshi wa / Fuji no takane no / yuki ni zo arikeru

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57af
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: としをへて / もゆてふふしの / 山よりも / あはぬ思ひは / 我そまされる
attributes.field_text_romaji: toshi o hete / moyu chō Fuji no / yama yori mo / awanu omoi wa / ware zo masareru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: toshi o hete / moyu chō Fuji no / yama yori mo / awanu omoi wa / ware zo masareru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Through all the passing years/ Burns Fuji;/ Far more than the mountain,/ Not meeting you, the flames of passion,/ Burn brightly in me.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57b0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: むねはふし / 袖は清見か / 関なれや / 煙もなみも / たたぬ日そなき
attributes.field_text_romaji: mune wa Fuji / sode wa Kiyomi ga / seki nare ya / keburi mo nami mo / tatanu hi zo naki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: mune wa Fuji / sode wa Kiyomi ga / seki nare ya / keburi mo nami mo / tatanu hi zo naki

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a57b1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 家に歌合し侍けるによめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 家に歌合し侍けるによめる
